vuln_add.vuln_name: Tornado请求体耗尽事件循环漏洞(CVE-2026-82397)
vuln_add.vuln_name_en: Tornado request body exhaustion event loop vulnerability (CVE-2026-82397)
vuln_add.technical_category: 不受控的资源消耗,输入中指定数量的不正确验证
vuln_add.description: Tornado 是 Python 的 Web 框架和异步网络库。在 6.5.8 之前，Tornado 在 tornado/escape.py 中使用 urllib.parse.parse_qs 解析 application/x-www-form-urlencoded 请求体，但未传递 max_num_fields 参数。tornado/web.py 中的 RequestHandler._execute 会通过 HTTPServerRequest._parse_body 和 tornado/httputil.py 中的 parse_body_arguments 在处理程序分发之前解析请求体，因此一个未经身份验证的请求体中包含数百万个以分隔符分隔的字段时，可能会同步阻塞单线程事件循环，并延迟所有连接。请求体的大小仅受 max_buffer_size 限制，默认值为 104857600 字节。该问题已在 6.5.8 版本中修复。
vuln_add.description_en: Tornado is a Python web framework and asynchronous networking library. Prior to 6.5.8, Tornado parses application/x-www-form-urlencoded request bodies with urllib.parse.parse_qs in tornado/escape.py without passing max_num_fields. RequestHandler._execute in tornado/web.py parses the body before handler dispatch through HTTPServerRequest._parse_body and parse_body_arguments in tornado/httputil.py, so an unauthenticated request body containing millions of separator-delimited fields can synchronously stall the single-threaded event loop and delay every connection. The body is bounded only by max_buffer_size, which defaults to 104857600 bytes. This issue is fixed in version 6.5.8.

vuln_add.vuln_name_en: pnpm Path Traversal and File Overwrite Vulnerability (CVE-2026-82393)
vuln_add.threat_category: 信息泄露,代码执行,拒绝服务
vuln_add.technical_category: 代码注入,路径名的限制不恰当,文件名或路径的外部可控制
vuln_add.description: pnpm 是一个软件包管理器。在 10.34.5 和 11.11.0 之前，pnpm 会接受 tarball 依赖项的 package.json 说明文件中作用域路径穿越的名称，因为 pnpm11/resolving/npm-resolver/src/pickPackage.ts 仅对非作用域名称拒绝斜杠字符。在 pnpm install 期间，未经过验证的名称会直接进入 pnpm11/installing/deps-resolver/src/resolvePeers.ts、pnpm11/installing/deps-resolver/src/index.ts 和 pnpm11/deps/graph-builder/src/lockfileToDepGraph.ts 中的原始路径拼接，导致软件包被解压到 node_modules 之外，并使攻击者控制的文件能够覆盖任意文件系统路径，即使使用了 --ignore-scripts 也会如此。这种覆盖可能替换 shell 启动文件、Git Hooks 或已安装软件包代码，并导致代码执行。该问题已在 10.34.5 和 11.11.0 版本中修复。
vuln_add.description_en: pnpm is a package manager. Prior to 10.34.5 and 11.11.0, pnpm accepts a scoped path traversal in a tarball dependency's package.json manifest name because pnpm11/resolving/npm-resolver/src/pickPackage.ts rejects slash characters only for unscoped names. During pnpm install, the unvalidated name reaches raw path joins in pnpm11/installing/deps-resolver/src/resolvePeers.ts, pnpm11/installing/deps-resolver/src/index.ts, and pnpm11/deps/graph-builder/src/lockfileToDepGraph.ts, causing package extraction outside node_modules and allowing attacker-controlled files to overwrite arbitrary filesystem paths even when --ignore-scripts is used. The overwrite can replace shell startup files, Git hooks, or installed package code and lead to code execution. This issue is fixed in versions 10.34.5, and 11.11.0.
vuln_add.vuln_type: 信息泄露,代码执行,拒绝服务

vuln_add.vuln_name: EasyAdmin仪表板路由控制器替换绕过漏洞(CVE-2026-81892)
vuln_add.vuln_name_en: EasyAdmin dashboard route controller replacement bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-81892)
vuln_add.threat_category: 权限提升,身份认证绕过
vuln_add.technical_category: 可控密钥绕过授权,授权机制不正确,未授权访问,通过用户可控密钥绕过授权
vuln_add.description: EasyAdmin 是用于 Symfony 应用的快速且现代化的后台生成器。从 4.0.0 到 4.29.16 以及 5.5.1 之前，EasyAdmin 通过单个仪表板路由处理所有后台请求，并且针对自定义操作（Action::linkToRoute() 和 MenuItem::linkToRoute()），会基于 kernel.controller 事件上的 routeName 查询参数交换执行的控制器。此交换发生在 Symfony 的安全防火墙已经针对原始仪表板 URL 评估了 access_control 之后，而且 routeName 值未经验证。结果就是，针对目标路由的路径式 access_control 规则从未被评估，因此，能够访问单个 EasyAdmin URL 且知道目标路由名称的低权限后台用户，可以执行该路由的控制器，从而绕过基于路径的规则。只有基于路径的保护会被绕过。其控制器使用 #[IsGranted] 或 denyAccessUnlessGranted() 强制执行自身授权的路由仍受到保护，因为这些检查会针对被替换进来的控制器重新计算。该问题已在 4.29.16 和 5.5.1 版本中修复。
vuln_add.description_en: EasyAdmin is a fast and modern admin generator for Symfony applications. From 4.0.0 until 4.29.16 and 5.5.1, EasyAdmin serves all backend requests through a single dashboard route and, for custom actions (Action::linkToRoute() and MenuItem::linkToRoute()), swaps the executed controller based on the routeName query parameter on the kernel.controller event. The swap happens after Symfony's security firewall has already evaluated access_control against the original dashboard URL, and the routeName value was not validated. As a result, a path-based access_control rule protecting the target route was never evaluated, so a low-privilege backend user who can reach a single EasyAdmin URL and knows a target route's name can execute that route's controller, bypassing the path-based rule. Only path-based protections are bypassed. Routes whose controller enforces its own authorization with #[IsGranted] or denyAccessUnlessGranted() remain protected because those checks are recomputed against the swapped-in controller. This issue is fixed in versions 4.29.16 and 5.5.1.
vuln_add.vuln_type: 权限提升,身份认证绕过

vuln_add.vuln_name_en: elFinder arbitrary file upload vulnerability (CVE-2026-81891)
vuln_add.description: elFinder 是一个面向 Web 的开源文件管理器，使用 JavaScript 配合 jQuery UI 编写。在 2.1.70 之前，`php/elFinderVolumeDriver.class.php` 中的 `checkExtractItems()` 会调用 `mimetypeInternalDetect()`，但未将结果通过 `mimeTypeNormalize()` 进行处理。由于 `.phtml`、`.phar`、`.php5` 和 `.php3` 扩展名未出现在 `mime.types` 中，因此将上述扩展名映射到 `text/x-php` 的 `staticMimeMap` 条目不会被应用，而 `allowPutMime()` 即使 `uploadDeny` 已阻止 `text/x-php`，仍然允许执行解压。具有 ZIP 上传权限的攻击者可将可执行 PHP 文件解压到 Web 可访问的 `files/` 目录中，并在服务器执行这些扩展名时实现远程代码执行。该问题已在版本 2.1.70 中修复。
vuln_add.description_en: elFinder is an open-source file manager for web, written in JavaScript using jQuery UI. Prior to 2.1.70, checkExtractItems() in php/elFinderVolumeDriver.class.php calls mimetypeInternalDetect() without passing the result through mimeTypeNormalize(). Because the .phtml, .phar, .php5, and .php3 extensions are absent from mime.types, the staticMimeMap entries that map them to text/x-php are not applied, and allowPutMime() permits extraction even when uploadDeny blocks text/x-php. An attacker with ZIP upload permission can extract PHP-executable files into a web-accessible files/ directory and achieve remote code execution when the server executes those extensions. This issue is fixed in version 2.1.70.

vuln_add.vuln_name_en: oasdiff-action-External Reference SSRF Vulnerability (CVE-2026-53507)
vuln_add.threat_category: 安全特性绕过,信息泄露,权限提升
vuln_add.technical_category: 信息暴露,不安全的资源默认值,服务器端请求伪造
vuln_add.description: oasdiff-action 是一个 GitHub Action，用于检测 OpenAPI 规范中的破坏性变更，并在每个拉取请求上发布审阅。在 0.0.51 之前的版本中，oasdiff action 默认会解析 OpenAPI 规范中的外部 `$refs`（`allow-external-refs: true`）。当 action 在一个拉取请求上运行时，如果其中的规范由攻击者控制——最重要的是公开仓库中的 fork 拉取请求——那么该规范中的 `$refs` 会在无需任何交互的情况下在运行器上被获取/读取，从而启用 SSRF，并泄露运行器上的结构化文件。该问题已在 0.0.51 版本中修复。
vuln_add.description_en: oasdiff-action is a GitHub Action that detects breaking changes in OpenAPI specs and post a review on every pull request. Before version 0.0.51, the oasdiff actions resolved external $refs in the OpenAPI spec by default (allow-external-refs: true). When an action runs on a pull request whose spec is attacker-controlled — most importantly fork pull requests on public repositories — a $ref in that spec is fetched/read on the runner with no interaction required, enabling SSRF and disclosure of structured files on the runner. This issue has been patched in version 0.0.51.
vuln_add.vuln_type: 安全特性绕过,信息泄露,权限提升

vuln_add.vuln_name_en: Hyperledger FireFly Webhook Subscription SSRF Vulnerability (CVE-2026-82957)
vuln_add.threat_category: 信息泄露,安全特性绕过
vuln_add.description: hyperledger-firefly firefly 1.4.0 及之前的版本中发现了一个漏洞。受影响的元素是文件 `internal/events/webhooks/webhooks.go` 中的组件 `Webhook Subscription` 的函数 `ValidateOptions`。对参数 `url` 的操纵会导致服务端请求伪造（SSRF）。远程利用该攻击是可能的。该利用方法已公开并可被使用。厂商早在披露之初就被联系了，但没有任何回应。
vuln_add.description_en: A vulnerability was found in hyperledger-firefly firefly up to 1.4.0. The impacted element is the function ValidateOptions of the file internal/events/webhooks/webhooks.go of the component Webhook Subscription. Performing a manipulation of the argument url results in server-side request forgery. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
vuln_add.vuln_type: 信息泄露,安全特性绕过

vuln_add.vuln_name_en: Devtron unauthorized token leakage vulnerability (CVE-2026-82882)
vuln_add.description: Devtron 在 2.2.0 及之前版本中未能对 `GET /orchestrator/api-token/webhook` 端点执行授权检查，导致经过身份验证的用户可以获取管理员 API 令牌。任何经过身份验证的攻击者都可通过向该端点查询任意项目、环境和应用参数，以明文形式获取超级管理员 JWT 令牌，从而完全控制平台。
vuln_add.description_en: Devtron through 2.2.0 fails to enforce authorization checks on the GET /orchestrator/api-token/webhook endpoint, allowing authenticated users to retrieve admin API tokens. Attackers with any authenticated account can query the endpoint with arbitrary project, environment, and application parameters to retrieve plaintext super-admin JWT tokens for full platform control.

vuln_add.vuln_name_en: Wallos unpatched SSRF vulnerability (CVE-2026-77348)
vuln_add.threat_category: 权限提升,信息泄露,代码执行,安全特性绕过
vuln_add.technical_category: 不安全的资源默认值,服务器端请求伪造,代理混淆
vuln_add.description: Wallos 是一款开源且可自托管的个人订阅追踪工具。在 5.0.0 版本之前，针对 CVE-2026-33407（GHSA-hhjq-82f8-m6rc，“通过 HTTP 代理环境变量触发 SSRF”）的修复通过对 endpoints/logos/search.php 禁用 cURL 代理（设置 CURLOPT_PROXY = '' 与 CURLOPT_NOPROXY = '*'）加强了安全性。然而，Wallos 还附带了一个第二个、几乎完全相同的、无需认证的 logo 图片搜索端点——endpoints/payments/search.php——该端点未获得同样的加固。它仍然直接将 HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY 环境变量传递给 CURLOPT_PROXY。该问题已在 5.0.0 版本中修复。
vuln_add.description_en: Wallos is an open-source, self-hostable personal subscription tracker. Prior to version 5.0.0, the fix for CVE-2026-33407 (GHSA-hhjq-82f8-m6rc, "SSRF via HTTP Proxy Environment Variable") hardened endpoints/logos/search.php by disabling cURL proxying (CURLOPT_PROXY = '' + CURLOPT_NOPROXY = '*'). However, Wallos ships a second, near-identical, unauthenticated logo-image search endpoint — endpoints/payments/search.php — that was not given the same hardening. It still passes the HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY environment variable straight into CURLOPT_PROXY. This issue has been patched in version 5.0.0.
vuln_add.vuln_type: 权限提升,信息泄露,代码执行,安全特性绕过

vuln_add.vuln_name_en: RESTEasy unauthenticated file read vulnerability (CVE-2026-17615)
vuln_add.threat_category: 代码执行,信息泄露,拒绝服务
vuln_add.description: RESTEasy 的 SourceProvider 中存在一个缺陷。该漏洞允许未经身份验证的攻击者执行未认证远程文件读取。通过向接收 application/xml 并返回 Source 或 StreamSource 的端点发送包含 DOCTYPE 声明且引用外部实体的特制 XML 主体，服务器可能被诱骗解析该实体并将敏感文件内容包含在 HTTP 响应中。这是由于 SourceProvider.writeTo() 方法在创建 SAXParser 时未禁用外部实体解析，从而导致 XML 外部实体（XXE）漏洞。
vuln_add.description_en: A flaw was found in RESTEasy's SourceProvider. This vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to perform an unauthenticated remote file read. By sending a specially crafted XML body with a DOCTYPE declaration referencing external entities to an endpoint that accepts application/xml and returns Source or StreamSource, the server can be tricked into resolving the entity and including sensitive file contents in the HTTP response. This is due to the SourceProvider.writeTo() method creating a SAXParser without disabling external entity resolution, leading to an XML External Entity (XXE) vulnerability.
vuln_add.vuln_type: 代码执行,信息泄露,拒绝服务

vuln_add.vuln_name_en: MCPHub IPv6 Transition Address SSRB Bypass Vulnerability (CVE-2026-79749)
vuln_add.threat_category: 信息泄露,安全特性绕过
vuln_add.description: MCPHub is a unified hub for centrally managing and dynamically orchestrating multiple MCP servers/APIs into separate endpoints with flexible routing strategies. Prior to version 1.0.32, MCPHub's SSRF guard in src/utils/ssrf.ts uses a custom isBlockedIpv6 function that only checks for loopback, link-local, unique-local, IPv4-mapped, and IPv4-compatible IPv6 addresses. IPv6 transition address families -- NAT64 (64:ff9b::/96), 6to4 (2002::/16), and Teredo (2001::/32) -- are not checked. An attacker who can specify a URL for an MCP server connection can encode a private IPv4 address inside one of these IPv6 forms to bypass the SSRF guard and reach internal infrastructure. This issue has been patched in version 1.0.32.
vuln_add.description_en: MCPHub is a unified hub for centrally managing and dynamically orchestrating multiple MCP servers/APIs into separate endpoints with flexible routing strategies. Prior to version 1.0.32, MCPHub's SSRF guard in src/utils/ssrf.ts uses a custom isBlockedIpv6 function that only checks for loopback, link-local, unique-local, IPv4-mapped, and IPv4-compatible IPv6 addresses. IPv6 transition address families -- NAT64 (64:ff9b::/96), 6to4 (2002::/16), and Teredo (2001::/32) -- are not checked. An attacker who can specify a URL for an MCP server connection can encode a private IPv4 address inside one of these IPv6 forms to bypass the SSRF guard and reach internal infrastructure. This issue has been patched in version 1.0.32.

vuln_add.vuln_name: Goploy越权文件操作与远程代码执行漏洞(CVE-2026-53552)
vuln_add.vuln_name_en: Goploy Unauthorized File Operations and Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (CVE-2026-53552)
vuln_add.threat_category: 身份认证绕过,权限提升
vuln_add.technical_category: 可控密钥绕过授权,授权机制不正确,通过用户可控密钥绕过授权
vuln_add.description: Goploy 是一个开源自动化部署系统。在 1.17.5 及之前版本中，`cmd/server/api/project/handler.go` 中的 `Project.AddFile`、`Project.EditFile`、`Project.RemoveFile` 和 `Project.Edit` 会从 JSON body 中获取 project 或 project-file row id 并对其执行操作，而不会检查该项目是否属于调用者的命名空间。对应的 `model.ProjectFile.GetData` 和 `model.Project.GetData` 查询仅按 row id 过滤。用户在自己的命名空间中具有 manager 角色（或任何包含 `FileSync` / `EditProject` 权限的角色）时，可以读取、写入或删除安装范围内任意项目中的文件，并可以通过在 body 中提交外部 id 来重写任意项目的 git remote URL。由于 `Edit` 会在项目的 working tree 上执行 `git remote set-url`，因此 git-url 原语可在下一次部署时提升到 RCE。在发布时，尚无已知的公开可用补丁。
vuln_add.description_en: Goploy is an open-source automation deployment system. In versions 1.17.5 and prior, Project.AddFile, Project.EditFile, Project.RemoveFile, and Project.Edit in cmd/server/api/project/handler.go accept a project or project-file row id from the JSON body and act on it without checking that the project belongs to the caller's namespace. The corresponding model.ProjectFile.GetData and model.Project.GetData queries filter only by row id. A user holding the manager role (or any role that includes the FileSync / EditProject permission) in their own namespace can read, write, or delete files in any project across the install, and can rewrite any project's git remote URL by submitting the foreign id in the body. The git-URL primitive escalates to RCE on the next deploy because Edit runs git remote set-url on the project's working tree. At time of publication, there are no known publicly available patches.
vuln_add.vuln_type: 身份认证绕过,权限提升

vuln_add.threat_category: 信息泄露,代码执行,拒绝服务
vuln_add.description: pnpm 是一个软件包管理器。在 10.34.5 之前以及 11.0.0 至 11.11.0 期间，pnpm 会从攻击者可控的 `pnpm-lock.yaml` 包的键中解析包名，使用方式为 `dp.parse(depPath).name`，并在 `deps/graph-builder/src/lockfileToDepGraph.ts` 与 `pnpm11/deps/graph-builder/src/lockfileToDepGraph.ts` 中未经过验证便使用该包名。该包名随后进入 `path.join(modules, pkgName)`、`storeController.importPackage` 以及 `pnpm11/lockfile/to-pnp/src/index.ts`，导致用户在运行 `pnpm install` 时，软件包内容可能被写入 `node_modules` 之外。当 `dangerouslyAllowAllBuilds` 或匹配的 `allowBuilds` 条目允许生命周期脚本时，被转义的包便可以用户的权限执行代码。该问题已在版本 10.34.5 和 11.11.0 中修复。
vuln_add.description_en: pnpm is a package manager. Prior to 10.34.5 and from 11.0.0 until 11.11.0, pnpm parses the package name from attacker-controlled pnpm-lock.yaml packages keys with dp.parse(depPath).name and uses it without validation in deps/graph-builder/src/lockfileToDepGraph.ts and pnpm11/deps/graph-builder/src/lockfileToDepGraph.ts. The name reaches path.join(modules, pkgName), storeController.importPackage, and pnpm11/lockfile/to-pnp/src/index.ts, allowing package contents to be written outside node_modules when a user runs pnpm install. When dangerouslyAllowAllBuilds or a matching allowBuilds entry permits lifecycle scripts, the escaped package can execute code with the user's privileges. This issue is fixed in versions 10.34.5 and 11.11.0.
vuln_add.vuln_type: 信息泄露,代码执行,拒绝服务

vuln_add.vuln_name_en: elFinder URL upload DNS rebinding SSRF vulnerability (CVE-2026-81889)
vuln_add.threat_category: 信息泄露,安全特性绕过
vuln_add.description: elFinder 是一个基于 Web 的开源文件管理器，使用 JavaScript 和 jQuery UI 编写。在 2.1.70 之前，php/elFinder.class.php 中的 elFinder URL 上传可在 PHP cURL 不可用时绕过服务端请求伪造保护，因为 validate_address() 验证的是 $info['ip']，而 get_remote_contents() 会选择 fsock_get_contents()，该函数会连接到 $arr['host'] 并进行第二次 DNS 解析。能够提交 URL 上传的攻击者可使用 DNS rebinding，使首次解析返回公网地址，并使连接解析返回回环地址或私有地址，从而将内部 HTTP 响应体存储为上传文件，并通过 elFinder 读取。成功获取后，get_headers($url, true) 会单独请求原始主机名，而不会复用已验证和绑定的连接，因此在即使选择了 curl_get_contents() 时，也会产生额外的盲服务端请求伪造路径。该问题已在 2.1.70 版本中修复。
vuln_add.description_en: elFinder is an open-source file manager for web, written in JavaScript using jQuery UI. Prior to 2.1.70, elFinder URL uploads in php/elFinder.class.php can bypass server-side request forgery protections when PHP cURL is unavailable because validate_address() validates $info['ip'], but get_remote_contents() selects fsock_get_contents(), which connects to $arr['host'] and performs a second DNS resolution. An attacker able to submit a URL upload can use DNS rebinding to have the first resolution return a public address and the connection resolution return a loopback or private address, causing the internal HTTP response body to be stored as an uploaded file and made readable through elFinder. After a successful fetch, get_headers($url, true) separately requests the original hostname without reusing the validated and pinned connection, creating an additional blind server-side request forgery path even when curl_get_contents() is selected. This issue is fixed in version 2.1.70.
vuln_add.vuln_type: 信息泄露,安全特性绕过

vuln_add.vuln_name_en: Livewire prototype pollution leads to XSS vulnerability (CVE-2026-81887)
vuln_add.technical_category: 跨站脚本攻击,原型污染
vuln_add.description: Livewire 是 Laravel 的一个全栈框架。从 3.0.0-beta.1 到 3.8.3 以及 4.3.4 之前的版本中，js/plugins/history/index.js 中的点表示法查询字符串解析器，包括 fromQueryString() 和 insertDotNotatedValueIntoData()，会接受 __proto__、constructor 和 prototype 路径片段，并创建继承对象。随后，客户端状态处理器在没有使用 Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call() 的情况下访问 effects.html、effects.js、effects.xjs 和 effects.scripts，导致攻击者受控的继承状态被当作受信任的效果处理。未认证的攻击者可以构造一个 URL，当用户打开该 URL 时，会在受影响应用的源上下文中执行任意 JavaScript。该漏洞利用需要用户交互，不会绕过服务器端授权，也不会授予超出受影响用户权限的特权。该问题已在 3.8.3 和 4.3.4 版本中修复。
vuln_add.description_en: Livewire is a full-stack framework for Laravel. From 3.0.0-beta.1 until 3.8.3 and 4.3.4, the dot-notated query-string parser in js/plugins/history/index.js, including fromQueryString() and insertDotNotatedValueIntoData(), accepts the __proto__, constructor, and prototype path segments and creates inherited objects. Client-side state handlers then access effects.html, effects.js, effects.xjs, and effects.scripts without Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(), allowing inherited attacker-controlled state to be treated as trusted effects. An unauthenticated attacker can craft a URL that, when opened by a user, executes arbitrary JavaScript in the affected application's origin. Exploitation requires user interaction and does not bypass server-side authorization or grant privileges beyond the affected user. This issue is fixed in versions 3.8.3 and 4.3.4.

vuln_add.vuln_name_en: Kirby media directory traversal vulnerability (CVE-2026-75594)
vuln_add.threat_category: 信息泄露,代码执行,拒绝服务
vuln_add.description: Kirby 是一款开源的内容管理系统。在 4.9.5 和 5.5.2 之前的版本中，根据发布线的不同，Kirby 的 src/Cms/Media.php 中的媒体处理器允许 Kirby\Cms\Media::thumb() 将一个包含路径的文件名追加到已验证的上级媒体目录中。在 nginx、PHP 内置服务器或启用了 AllowEncodedSlashes 的 Apache 上，远程攻击者可以在文件名中提交编码后的斜杠字符，如 %2f，从而遍历到上级媒体目录之外。针对存在和不存在的缩略图配置的不同响应会泄露任意 .json 文件是否存在，而包含有效文件名键的 .json 文件可能导致返回所引用的图像并删除任务文件。src/Filesystem/Asset.php 中相关的 file::version 路径也接受了目标索引根目录之外的 ../ 序列。该问题已在 4.9.5 和 5.5.2 版本中修复。
vuln_add.description_en: Kirby is an open-source content management system. Prior to 4.9.5 and 5.5.2, depending on the release line, Kirby's media handler in src/Cms/Media.php allowed Kirby\Cms\Media::thumb() to append a path-bearing filename to a validated parent media directory. On nginx, PHP's built-in server, or Apache with AllowEncodedSlashes enabled, a remote attacker could submit encoded slash characters such as %2f in the filename and traverse outside the parent's media directory. Differences between responses for existing and nonexistent thumbnail configurations disclosed whether an arbitrary .json file existed, and a .json file containing a valid filename key could cause the referenced image to be returned and the job file to be deleted. The related file::version path in src/Filesystem/Asset.php also accepted ../ sequences outside the intended index root. This issue is fixed in versions 4.9.5 and 5.5.2.
vuln_add.vuln_type: 信息泄露,代码执行,拒绝服务

vuln_add.vuln_name: Kirby媒体处理器路径穿越漏洞(CVE-2026-75592)
vuln_add.vuln_name_en: Kirby media processor path traversal vulnerability (CVE-2026-75592)
vuln_add.threat_category: 信息泄露,代码执行,拒绝服务
vuln_add.description: Kirby 是一个开源的内容管理系统。在 4.9.5 和 5.5.2 之前的版本中，根据发布线不同，Kirby 的媒体处理器在 src/Filesystem/Dir.php 和 src/Filesystem/F.php 中通过 Kirby\Filesystem\Dir::realpath() 和 Kirby\Filesystem\F::realpath() 使用了 incomplete filesystem containment checks。这些检查接受了与预期根路径共享字符串前缀的兄弟目录，例如 /var/www/site2 紧邻 /var/www/site，因为它们不要求完全匹配或 DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR 边界。远程攻击者可以利用 Kirby\Cms\Media::thumb()，当该目录中包含有效的 .json 缩略图作业文件时，创建并访问 PHP 可读的兄弟目录中图像文件的缩略图，从而可能暴露 staging 站点、备份或其他内部站点，并在处理过程中删除作业文件。该问题已在版本 4.9.5 和 5.5.2 中修复。
vuln_add.description_en: Kirby is an open-source content management system. Prior to 4.9.5 and 5.5.2, depending on the release line, Kirby's media handler used incomplete filesystem containment checks in src/Filesystem/Dir.php and src/Filesystem/F.php through Kirby\Filesystem\Dir::realpath() and Kirby\Filesystem\F::realpath(). The checks accepted a sibling directory whose path shared the intended root's string prefix, such as /var/www/site2 next to /var/www/site, because they did not require an exact match or a DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR boundary. A remote attacker could use Kirby\Cms\Media::thumb() to create and access thumbnails from image files in a PHP-readable sibling directory when that directory contained a valid .json thumbnail job file, potentially exposing staging sites, backups, or other internal sites and deleting the job file during processing. This issue is fixed in versions 4.9.5 and 5.5.2.
vuln_add.vuln_type: 信息泄露,代码执行,拒绝服务

vuln_add.vuln_name: XueZhiSi考试系统越权删除漏洞(CVE-2026-75458)
vuln_add.vuln_name_en: XueZhiSi Exam System Unauthorized Deletion Vulnerability (CVE-2026-75458)
vuln_add.description: XueZhiSi Open Exam System 3.9.0 及更早版本的教师端接口 `POST /api/teacher/user/delete/{id}` 存在垂直权限提升漏洞。该接口接受用户 ID，随后依次执行 `getUserById(id)`、`setDeleted(true)`、`updateByIdFilter()`，但未对当前用户是否具备删除目标用户的权限进行任何校验。已认证的教师用户（role=2）可以删除管理员账户（role=3），构成垂直权限提升，即低权限用户执行了高权限操作。
vuln_add.description_en: The teacher-end interface POST /api/teacher/user/delete/{id} in XueZhiSi Open Source Exam System <= 3.9.0 contains a vertical privilege escalatio vulnerability. This interface accepts a user ID and then executes getUserById(id), setDeleted(true), updateByIdFilter() in sequence, without any validation of whether the current user has the authority to delete the target user. An authenticated teacher user (role=2) can delete an administrator account (role=3), constituting a vertical privilege escalation where a lower-privileged user performs a high-privileged operation.

vuln_add.vuln_name_en: Smarty Open Redirect SSRF Vulnerability (CVE-2026-62993)
vuln_add.threat_category: 信息泄露,安全特性绕过
vuln_add.description: Smarty 是 PHP 的模板引擎，用于将表现层（HTML/CSS）与应用逻辑分离。在 4.5.7 和 5.8.2 之前的版本中，根据发布分支不同，Smarty 在 libs/plugins/function.fetch.php 以及 src/FunctionHandler/Fetch.php 中的 {fetch} 处理逻辑，在安全策略处于激活状态时，仅使用 Security::isTrustedUri() 对初始远程 URL 依据 trusted_uri 进行校验。对于由 file_get_contents() 处理的资源，包括 HTTPS URL，在默认情况下 PHP 会跟随 HTTP 重定向。攻击者如果能够提供或影响 fetch 目标，并且在受信任主机上存在开放重定向，则可将请求重定向到攻击者选择的内部端点，绕过 trusted_uri 白名单，从而实施服务器端请求伪造（SSRF）。该问题已在 4.5.7 和 5.8.2 版本中修复。
vuln_add.description_en: Smarty is a template engine for PHP, facilitating the separation of presentation (HTML/CSS) from application logic. Prior to 4.5.7 and 5.8.2, depending on the release line, Smarty's {fetch} handling in libs/plugins/function.fetch.php and src/FunctionHandler/Fetch.php used Security::isTrustedUri() to validate only the initial remote URL against trusted_uri when a security policy was active. For resources handled by file_get_contents(), including HTTPS URLs, PHP followed HTTP redirects by default. An attacker who could supply or influence a fetch target and had an open redirect on a trusted host could redirect the request to an attacker-chosen internal endpoint, bypass the trusted_uri allowlist, and perform server-side request forgery. This issue is fixed in versions 4.5.7 and 5.8.2.
vuln_add.vuln_type: 信息泄露,安全特性绕过

vuln_add.vuln_name: Wallos-OIDC邮箱验证缺失账户接管漏洞(CVE-2026-61641)
vuln_add.vuln_name_en: Wallos-OIDC Missing Email Verification Leads to Account Takeover Vulnerability (CVE-2026-61641)
vuln_add.description: Wallos 是一款开源、可自托管的个人订阅跟踪工具。在 4.0.0 版本至 4.9.6 之前的版本中，Wallos 的 OIDC 登录仅通过匹配 email 声明就将传入的 OIDC 身份关联到现有的本地账户，而未验证身份提供者（IdP）是否已将邮箱标记为已验证（email_verified）。当 Wallos 配置在与允许用户出示任意或未验证邮箱的 IdP 连接时（例如多租户 IdP、开放自助注册的 IdP，或攻击者能够部分控制的任何 IdP），一个没有 Wallos 账户的攻击者可以使用管理员邮箱进行身份验证，并以管理员身份登录——实现完整的账户接管，无需密码。该问题已在 4.9.6 版本中修复。
vuln_add.description_en: Wallos is an open-source, self-hostable personal subscription tracker. From version 4.0.0 to before version 4.9.6, Wallos's OIDC login links an incoming OIDC identity to an existing local account by matching the email claim alone, without verifying that the IdP marked that email as verified (email_verified). When Wallos is configured against an IdP that lets a user present an arbitrary or unverified email (multi-tenant IdPs, IdPs with open self-registration, or any IdP the attacker partly controls), an attacker with no Wallos account can authenticate with the admin's email and be logged in as the admin — full account takeover, no password needed. This issue has been patched in version 4.9.6.

vuln_add.vuln_name_en: Wallos-OIDC configuration SSRF vulnerability (CVE-2026-61640)
vuln_add.threat_category: 信息泄露,安全特性绕过
vuln_add.description: Wallos 是一款开源、可自我托管的个人订阅追踪工具。在 4.9.6 版本之前，`includes/oidc/handle_oidc_callback.php:18-49` 中由管理员配置的 OIDC `token_url` 和 `user_info_url` 会直接传入 `curl_init()`，且完全没有进行 SSRF 过滤。与经过 `validate_webhook_url_for_ssrf()` 保护的 logo/webhook  URL 不同，OIDC URL 绕过了全部防护。管理员可将 URL 设置为 `http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/` 以访问云元数据或进行内网跳转。该问题已在 4.9.6 版本中修复。

Prior to version 4.9.6, Admin-configured OIDC token_url and user_info_url in includes/oidc/handle_oidc_callback.php:18-49 are used directly in curl_init() with zero SSRF filtering. Unlike logo/webhook URLs which have validate_webhook_url_for_ssrf(), OIDC URLs bypass all protections. Admin sets URL to http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/ for cloud metadata access or internal network pivoting. This issue has been patched in version 4.9.6.

vuln_add.vuln_name_en: Wallos arbitrary file write vulnerability (CVE-2026-61639)
vuln_add.threat_category: 信息泄露,代码执行,拒绝服务
vuln_add.description: Wallos 是一款开源、支持自托管的个人订阅追踪工具。在 4.9.6 之前的版本中，POST /endpoints/db/restore.php 会调用 ZipArchive::extractTo()，但未对条目标签中的 ../ 序列进行验证。管理员上传精心构造的 zip 文件，其中包含条目标识为 logos/../../endpoints/shell.php，从而将 webshell 写入网站根目录。扩展名过滤器仅在解压后的 logo 复制步骤生效。该问题已在 4.9.6 版本中修复。
vuln_add.description_en: Wallos is an open-source, self-hostable personal subscription tracker. Prior to version 4.9.6, POST /endpoints/db/restore.php calls ZipArchive::extractTo() without validating entry names for ../ sequences. Admin uploads crafted zip with entry logos/../../endpoints/shell.php to write webshell to webroot. Extension filter only applies to post-extraction logo copy step. This issue has been patched in version 4.9.6.
vuln_add.vuln_type: 信息泄露,代码执行,拒绝服务

vuln_add.vuln_name_en: Wallos email notification SSRF vulnerability (CVE-2026-61638)
vuln_add.threat_category: 信息泄露,安全特性绕过
vuln_add.description: Wallos 是一款开源、可自我托管的个人订阅追踪工具。在 4.9.6 版本之前，POST /endpoints/notifications/testemailnotifications.php 接受来自 POST 请求体的 smtpaddress 和 smtpport，且没有任何 SSRF 校验。PHPMailer 会连接到攻击者提供的 host:port。其他所有通知端点都使用 ssrf_helper.php，但邮件功能被遗漏了。任何已认证用户都可以探测内部网络和云元数据。该问题已在 4.9.6 版本中修复。
vuln_add.description_en: Wallos is an open-source, self-hostable personal subscription tracker. Prior to version 4.9.6, POST /endpoints/notifications/testemailnotifications.php accepts smtpaddress and smtpport from POST body with zero SSRF validation. PHPMailer connects to attacker-supplied host:port. Every other notification endpoint uses ssrf_helper.php but email was missed. Any authenticated user can probe internal network, cloud metadata. This issue has been patched in version 4.9.6.
vuln_add.vuln_type: 信息泄露,安全特性绕过

vuln_add.vuln_name: eObčanka-自定义URL方案命令注入漏洞(CVE-2026-59111)
vuln_add.vuln_name_en: eObčanka-custom URL scheme command injection vulnerability (CVE-2026-59111)
vuln_add.description: Digitální a informační agentura (DIA) eObčanka-Identifikate 在 MacOS 上的“操作系统命令中和不当，导致可使用 OS 命令注入”漏洞，可使攻击者注册自定义 URL 协议（czeeopauth://）用于带参数的应用程序执行。在 3.6.0 版本之前，传入的 URL 参数在未充分清理的情况下，通过连接方式传递给了编译后的 AppleScript 包装器。

vuln_add.vuln_name: QD-未授权SSRF与禁用TLS验证漏洞(CVE-2026-51152)
vuln_add.vuln_name_en: QD - Unauthorized SSRF and Disabled TLS Validation Vulnerability (CVE-2026-51152)
vuln_add.threat_category: 安全特性绕过,信息泄露
vuln_add.description: 服务器端请求伪造（SSRF）：QD 20220208 至 20250803 版本中，`/har/test` 端点存在此问题。`libs/fetcher.py` 中的 `Fetcher.build_request()` 会基于用户提供的 JSON 构造 `httpclient.HTTPRequest`，但并未验证 URL 协议、主机名或 IP 范围。`/har/test` 处理程序无需认证，这使得未经身份验证的远程攻击者能够强迫 QD 服务器向内部网络资源和云元数据端点发送任意 HTTP 请求。`validate_cert` 被设置为 `False`，从而禁用了 TLS 验证。
vuln_add.description_en: Server-side request forgery (SSRF) in the /har/test endpoint in QD 20220208 through 20250803. Fetcher.build_request() in libs/fetcher.py constructs an httpclient.HTTPRequest from user-supplied JSON without validating URL scheme, host, or IP range. The /har/test handler does not require authentication, enabling unauthenticated remote attackers to force the QD server to send arbitrary HTTP requests to internal network resources and cloud metadata endpoints. validate_cert is set to False, disabling TLS verification.
vuln_add.vuln_type: 安全特性绕过,信息泄露

vuln_add.vuln_name_en: MCPHub unauthorized tool invocation vulnerability (CVE-2026-79750)
vuln_add.technical_category: 可控密钥绕过授权,通过用户可控密钥绕过授权
vuln_add.description: MCPHub 是一个统一的中心枢纽，用于集中管理并动态编排多个 MCP 服务器/API，将其映射到具有灵活路由策略的独立端点。在 1.0.30 之前的版本中，MCPHub 对非管理员用户在所属服务器上的权限进行了限制（列表查看和配置编辑会校验归属），但工具执行 API 未作此限制。任何已认证的非管理员用户都可以对由其他用户拥有的 MCP 服务器调用工具——这些服务器甚至无法在 GET /api/servers 中看到。由于所连接的 MCP 服务器具备真实能力（文件系统、HTTP 获取、带有所有者密钥的云 API），因此这是一个跨租户权限破坏问题：已演示任意主机文件读取（/etc/passwd、其他用户密钥）和 SSRF。该问题已在版本 1.0.30 中修复。
vuln_add.description_en: MCPHub is a unified hub for centrally managing and dynamically orchestrating multiple MCP servers/APIs into separate endpoints with flexible routing strategies. Prior to version 1.0.30, MCPHub scopes non-admin users to servers they own (list views and config edits enforce ownership), but the tool-execution API does not. Any authenticated non-admin user can invoke tools on MCP servers owned by other users — servers they cannot even see in GET /api/servers. Because connected MCP servers carry real capability (filesystem, HTTP fetch, cloud APIs with the owner's keys), this is cross-tenant compromise: demonstrated arbitrary host file read (/etc/passwd, another user's secrets) and SSRF. This issue has been patched in version 1.0.30.

vuln_add.vuln_name_en: MCPHub Unauthorized Command Execution Vulnerability (CVE-2026-79748)
vuln_add.description:
MCPHub 是一个统一的中心枢纽，用于集中管理并以动态方式编排多个 MCP 服务器/API，将其映射到具有灵活路由策略的独立端点。在 0.12.15 版本之前，MCPHub 的 POST /api/servers 和 PUT /api/servers/:name 端点用于创建/更新 MCP 服务器配置，并随后立即通过 child_process.spawn 启动配置的 stdio 进程。

该接口要求认证，但对这些端点没有任何授权检查来限制其仅对管理员开放，并且 command 和 args 字段也没有白名单或净化处理。因此，任何经过认证的普通非管理员用户都可以提交一个服务器配置，将 command 设置为 "/bin/sh"（或其他任意二进制程序）并携带任意 args，从而导致 MCPHub 以 MCPHub 服务器操作系统用户身份（在官方发布的 Docker 镜像以及 npx/systemd 部署中通常为 root）执行攻击者控制的进程。

该问题已在 0.12.15 版本中修复。
vuln_add.description_en: MCPHub is a unified hub for centrally managing and dynamically orchestrating multiple MCP servers/APIs into separate endpoints with flexible routing strategies. Prior to version 0.12.15, the POST /api/servers and PUT /api/servers/:name endpoints in MCPHub create/update MCP server configurations and then immediately spawn the configured stdio process via child_process.spawn. Authentication is required, but there is no authorization check restricting these endpoints to admins, and there is no allowlist/sanitization on the command and args fields. As a result, any authenticated non-admin user can submit a server configuration with command:"/bin/sh" (or any other binary) and arbitrary args, causing MCPHub to execute the attacker-controlled process as the MCPHub server's OS user (commonly root in the published Docker image and in npx/systemd deployments). This issue has been patched in version 0.12.15.

vuln_add.vuln_name_en: MCPHub unauthorized SSRF vulnerability (CVE-2026-79747)
vuln_add.threat_category: 信息泄露,安全特性绕过
vuln_add.description: MCPHub 是一个统一的中枢，用于集中管理并动态编排多个 MCP 服务器/API，映射为具有灵活路由策略的独立端点。在 1.0.32 版本之前，经过认证的非管理员用户可注册一个指向任意 URL 的服务器，并使中枢向其发出服务器端请求，且没有出站过滤（未阻止回环 / RFC1918 / 链路本地 169.254.0.0/16）。通过 OpenAPI 代理路径，响应体会完整返回给调用方（完整的反射型 SSRF）；通过 SSE/streamable-http 传输时，请求则以盲发方式发出。该问题已在 1.0.32 版本中修复。
vuln_add.description_en: MCPHub is a unified hub for centrally managing and dynamically orchestrating multiple MCP servers/APIs into separate endpoints with flexible routing strategies. Prior to version 1.0.32, an authenticated non-admin user can register a server pointing at an arbitrary URL and make the hub issue server-side requests to it, with no egress filtering (no block of loopback / RFC1918 / link-local 169.254.0.0/16). Via the OpenAPI proxy path the response body is returned to the caller (full, reflected SSRF); via the SSE/streamable-http transport the request is sent blind. This issue has been patched in version 1.0.32.
vuln_add.vuln_type: 信息泄露,安全特性绕过

vuln_add.vuln_name_en: MCPHub group route unauthorized access vulnerability (CVE-2026-79746)
vuln_add.description: MCPHub 是一个统一枢纽，用于集中管理并将多个 MCP 服务器/API 动态编排为带有灵活路由策略的独立端点。在 1.0.31 版本之前，当对组路由使用 `accessType: 'servers'`（或 `'custom'`）的 bearer key 时，只要该组中任意单个服务器出现在该 key 的 `allowedServers` 列表中，`isBearerKeyAllowedForRequest` 就会授予对整个组的访问权限——而不仅限于该 key 所限制的所有服务器都匹配的情况，并且在组级连接获得授权后，不会再重新检查 `allowedServers`。因此，明确限定为一个特定服务器的 key 也会授予与其共享同一组的所有其他服务器的完全访问权限，包括该 key 从未被授权过的服务器。此问题已在 1.0.31 版本中修复。
vuln_add.description_en: MCPHub is a unified hub for centrally managing and dynamically orchestrating multiple MCP servers/APIs into separate endpoints with flexible routing strategies. Prior to version 1.0.31, when a bearer key with accessType: 'servers' (or 'custom') is used against a group route, isBearerKeyAllowedForRequest grants access to the entire group as long as any single server in that group appears in the key's allowedServers list — not only when every server the key is scoped to matches, and critically, without ever re-checking allowedServers again once the group-level connection is authorized. A key explicitly scoped to one specific server therefore also grants full access to every other server that happens to share a group with it, including servers the key was never authorized for. This issue has been patched in version 1.0.31.

vuln_add.vuln_name: MCPHub未授权全局提示篡改漏洞(CVE-2026-79745)
vuln_add.vuln_name_en: MCPHub Unauthorized Global Prompt Tampering Vulnerability (CVE-2026-79745)
vuln_add.description: MCPHub 是一个统一中心枢纽，用于集中管理并将多个 MCP 服务器/API 动态编排为带有灵活路由策略的独立端点。在 1.0.32 版本之前，内置的提示（prompt）和资源控制器不执行任何角色检查。 mutating POST/PUT /api/prompts* 和 POST/PUT /api/resources* 路由被附加到已认证路由器上，但没有任何管理员门控，且处理程序从未读取 req.user。它们写入的 DAO 单例会在 handleGetPromptRequest / handleReadResourceRequest 中为每个会话首先被查询——优先于任何已连接的 MCP 服务器。因此，非管理员用户可以创建、覆盖并遮蔽所有其他用户都会获取到的全局提示模板和资源。评分影响是对未授权完整性违反（对全局分发记录的创建/篡改/遮蔽）；向其他用户 LLM 会话中植入存储提示则是该篡改的下游后果。该问题已在 1.0.32 版本中修复。
vuln_add.description_en: MCPHub is a unified hub for centrally managing and dynamically orchestrating multiple MCP servers/APIs into separate endpoints with flexible routing strategies. Prior to version 1.0.32, the built-in prompt and resource controllers perform no role checking. The mutating POST/PUT /api/prompts* and POST/PUT /api/resources* routes are attached to the authenticated router with no admin gate, and the handlers never read req.user. The DAO singletons they write are consulted first — ahead of any connected MCP server — for every session in handleGetPromptRequest / handleReadResourceRequest. A non-admin can therefore create, overwrite, and shadow global prompt templates and resources that all other users are served. The scored impact is the unauthorized integrity violation (creation/tampering/shadowing of globally-served records); stored prompt injection into other users' LLM sessions is a downstream consequence of that tampering. This issue has been patched in version 1.0.32.

vuln_add.vuln_name_en: MCPHub configuration interface unauthorized vulnerability (CVE-2026-79744)
vuln_add.threat_category: 权限提升,身份认证绕过
vuln_add.technical_category: 特权管理不当,未授权访问
vuln_add.description: MCPHub 是一个统一中心枢纽，用于集中管理和动态编排多个 MCP 服务器/API 到带有灵活路由策略的独立端点。在 1.0.29 版本之前，MCPHub 的 PUT /api/system-config 端点（handler updateSystemConfig）不执行任何授权检查。它仅由应用范围的认证中间件和速率限制器进行保护——它从不检查 req.user.isAdmin。该问题已在版本 1.0.29 中修复。
vuln_add.description_en: MCPHub is a unified hub for centrally managing and dynamically orchestrating multiple MCP servers/APIs into separate endpoints with flexible routing strategies. Prior to version 1.0.29, MCPHub's PUT /api/system-config endpoint (handler updateSystemConfig) performs no authorization check. It is protected only by the app-wide authentication middleware and a rate limiter — it never inspects req.user.isAdmin. This issue has been patched in version 1.0.29.
vuln_add.vuln_type: 权限提升,身份认证绕过

vuln_add.vuln_name_en: MCPHub arbitrary file write vulnerability (CVE-2026-79743)
vuln_add.threat_category: 拒绝服务,信息泄露,代码执行
vuln_add.description: MCPHub 是一个统一的中心枢纽，用于集中管理并通过灵活的路由策略动态编排多个 MCP 服务器/API 到独立端点。在 0.12.13 版本之前，MCPB File Upload Handler 会解压 ZIP 文件并读取其中的 manifest.json。manifest.json 中的 name 字段（第 107 行）会未经任何清理或路径遍历字符验证就直接拼接到文件路径中。攻击者可以构造一个恶意 MCPB 文件，使 manifest.name 被设置为类似于 ../../../etc/malicious 的内容，导致该文件被解压到文件系统上的任意位置。cleanupOldMcpbServer 函数（第 110 行）也使用了未经清理的名称，可能允许删除任意目录。该问题已在 0.12.13 版本中修复。
vuln_add.description_en: MCPHub is a unified hub for centrally managing and dynamically orchestrating multiple MCP servers/APIs into separate endpoints with flexible routing strategies. Prior to version 0.12.13, MCPB File Upload Handler extracts a ZIP file and reads manifest.json from it. The name field in the manifest is directly concatenated into a file path (line 107) without any sanitization or path traversal character validation. An attacker can craft a malicious MCPB file where manifest.name is set to something like ../../../etc/malicious, causing the file to be extracted to an arbitrary location on the file system. The cleanupOldMcpbServer function (line 110) also uses the unsanitized name, potentially allowing deletion of arbitrary directories. This issue has been patched in version 0.12.13.
vuln_add.vuln_type: 拒绝服务,信息泄露,代码执行

vuln_add.description_en: Unrestricted deserialization of untrusted data in the cursor pagination component in the OpenSearch SQL plugin allows a remote authenticated user with basic read/search permissions to execute arbitrary code on the server by sending a crafted cursor parameter to the plugins/sql endpoint.

vuln_add.vuln_name_en: Pangolin authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-72001)
vuln_add.technical_category: 可控密钥绕过授权,通过用户可控密钥绕过授权
vuln_add.description: Pangolin 在 1.22.0 之前版本中存在身份验证绕过漏洞。攻击者可通过向 share-link 身份验证端点提供一个由攻击者控制的 URL 参数，并在令牌验证调用中省略预期的资源标识符，从而在未认证的情况下访问任何受保护资源。持有任意资源的有效共享链接的攻击者，可以跨不同组织对任意资源进行身份验证，绕过所有已配置的身份验证方式，包括 SSO、资源密码、PIN 码、邮件白名单以及基于头部的身份验证。
vuln_add.description_en: Pangolin before 1.22.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to access any protected resource by supplying an attacker-controlled URL parameter to the share-link authentication endpoint that omits the expected resource identifier from the token verification call. Attackers holding a single valid share link for any resource can authenticate against arbitrary resources across different organizations, bypassing all configured authentication methods including SSO, resource passwords, PIN codes, email allowlists, and header authentication.

vuln_add.vuln_name_en: GDB-STABS out-of-bounds write vulnerability (CVE-2026-13732)
vuln_add.description:
GDB 的 STABS 调试格式解析器中存在一个缺陷。

gdb/stabsread.c 中的 read_member_functions() 函数在处理 C++ 类的析构函数和非析构函数成员函数的分离代码时，存在链表移除缺陷。该缺陷会导致析构函数条目保留在主函数列表中，而列表长度计数器却被递减，从而在将函数列表复制到底层已分配数组时发生越界写入。攻击者可构造带有恶意 .stab 和 .stabstr 节的 ELF 二进制文件，当用户在 GDB 中打开该文件并执行任意符号检查操作（例如设置断点）时，就会触发该越界写入。无需执行被调试进程。在受控条件下，已演示该漏洞可实现 GDB 进程内的任意命令执行。
vuln_add.description_en:
A flaw was found in GDB's STABS debug format parser. The
read_member_functions() function in gdb/stabsread.c contains a linked
list removal bug in the code that separates destructor and non-destructor
member functions of C++ classes. The bug causes the destructor entries to
remain in the main function list while the list length counter is
decremented, resulting in an out-of-bounds write when the function list
is copied to its final allocated array. An attacker can craft an ELF
binary with malicious .stab and .stabstr sections that triggers this
out-of-bounds write when a user opens the file in GDB and performs any
symbol-inspection operation such as setting a breakpoint. The inferior
process does not need to be executed. Under controlled conditions, this
was demonstrated to achieve execution of arbitrary commands within the
GDB process.

vuln_add.vuln_name_en: Dokploy Path Traversal Vulnerability (CVE-2026-82954)
vuln_add.threat_category: 信息泄露,代码执行,拒绝服务
vuln_add.description: 在 Dokploy 0.29.7 及更早版本中发现了一个漏洞。此问题影响 component Settings 中文件 packages/server/src/utils/traefik/application.ts 的 writeTraefikConfigInPath 函数。对参数 path 的操作会导致路径遍历。攻击者可远程发起攻击。该利用方法现已公开，且可能已被使用。厂商早期已被联系本披露事项，但未作出任何回应。
vuln_add.description_en: A vulnerability was detected in Dokploy up to 0.29.7. This issue affects the function writeTraefikConfigInPath of the file packages/server/src/utils/traefik/application.ts of the component Settings. The manipulation of the argument path results in path traversal. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
vuln_add.vuln_type: 信息泄露,代码执行,拒绝服务

vuln_add.vuln_name_en: Wallos-OIDC state validation missing vulnerability (CVE-2026-54599)
vuln_add.description: Wallos 是一款开源、可自行托管的个人订阅追踪工具。在 4.9.4 版本之前，login.php 会生成一个存储在 `$_SESSION['oidc_state']` 中的 OIDC state nonce，但 checksession.php 在处理 OIDC 回调时并未将传入的 state 与会话中的值进行比较。攻击者可诱导受害者访问一个精心构造的 URL，导致 Wallos 使用该攻击者的授权码进行交换，并将受害者登录到攻击者的账户。该问题已在 4.9.4 版本中修复。
vuln_add.description_en: Wallos is an open-source, self-hostable personal subscription tracker. Prior to version 4.9.4, login.php generates an OIDC state nonce stored in $_SESSION['oidc_state'], but checksession.php dispatches the OIDC callback without comparing the incoming state against the session value. An attacker can trick a victim into visiting a crafted URL, causing Wallos to exchange the attacker's authorization code and log the victim into the attacker's account. This issue has been patched in version 4.9.4.

vuln_update.vuln_name: Ray AI 计算引擎远程代码执行漏洞(CVE-2025-62593)
vuln_update.vuln_name_en: Remote Code Execution Vulnerability in Ray AI Computing Engine (CVE-2025-62593)
vuln_update.technical_category: 跨站请求伪造,代码注入
vuln_update.description: Ray是一款人工智能计算引擎，用于提高开发人员在机器学习和人工智能项目中的计算效率。在2.52.0版本之前，Ray存在一个严重的远程代码执行漏洞，该漏洞可以通过Firefox和Safari浏览器被利用。原因是Ray对基于浏览器的攻击防护不足，当前的防护机制仅依赖于以'Mozilla'开头的User-Agent头部作为防御手段，而fetch规范允许修改User-Agent头部，导致这种防护机制不充分。结合DNS重绑定攻击，该漏洞可以被用来攻击运行Ray的开发者，尤其是当他们无意中访问恶意网站或看到恶意广告时。
vuln_update.description_en: Ray is an AI computing engine designed to improve computational efficiency for developers working on machine learning and AI projects. Prior to version 2.52.0, Ray had a critical remote code execution vulnerability that could be exploited via Firefox and Safari browsers. The issue arises from insufficient browser-based attack protection in Ray. The current defense mechanism relies solely on the User-Agent header starting with 'Mozilla', but the fetch specification allows modification of the User-Agent header, making this defense inadequate. Combined with DNS rebinding attacks, this vulnerability can be used to target developers running Ray, especially when they inadvertently visit malicious websites or encounter malicious advertisements.

vuln_update.vuln_name: DIYgod RSSHub代码执行漏洞(CVE-2024-47179)
vuln_update.threat_category: 拒绝服务,代码执行,信息泄露
vuln_update.description: RSSHub 是一个 RSS 网络。在提交 64e00e7 之前，RSSHub 的 `docker-test-cont.yml` 工作流容易受到工件投毒的攻击，这可能导致对整个仓库的接管。RSSHub 的下游用户不受此问题的影响，提交 64e00e7 修复了根本问题，使仓库不再容易受到攻击。`docker-test-cont.yml` 工作流在 `PR - Docker build test` 工作流成功完成后被触发。然后它收集一些关于触发触发工作流的拉取请求的信息，并根据 PR 本体和发送者设置一些标签。如果 PR 还包含一个 `routes` markdown 块，它将设置 `TEST_CONTINUE` 环境变量为 `true`。然后工作流下载并提取触发工作流上传的工件，预期包含一个 `rsshub.tar.zst` 文件。然而，在提交 64e00e7 之前，它没有验证内容，而是在工作区的根目录中提取，覆盖任何现有文件。由于工件的内容没有验证，恶意行为者有可能发送一个拉取请求，上传的不仅仅是 `rsshub.tar.zst` 压缩的 Docker 镜像，还有一个包含在特权工作流上下文中运行任意代码的脚本的恶意 `package.json` 文件。从提交 64e00e7 开始，这种情况已经得到解决，RSSHub 仓库不再容易受到攻击。
vuln_update.description_en: RSSHub is an RSS network. Prior to commit 64e00e7, RSSHub's `docker-test-cont.yml` workflow is vulnerable to Artifact Poisoning, which could have lead to a full repository takeover. Downstream users of RSSHub are not vulnerable to this issue, and commit 64e00e7 fixed the underlying issue and made the repository no longer vulnerable. The `docker-test-cont.yml` workflow gets triggered when the `PR - Docker build test` workflow completes successfully. It then collects some information about the Pull Request that triggered the triggering workflow and set some labels depending on the PR body and sender. If the PR also contains a `routes` markdown block, it will set the `TEST_CONTINUE` environment variable to `true`. The workflow then downloads and extracts an artifact uploaded by the triggering workflow which is expected to contain a single `rsshub.tar.zst` file. However, prior to commit 64e00e7, it did not validate and the contents were extracted in the root of the workspace overriding any existing files. Since the contents of the artifact were not validated, it is possible for a malicious actor to send a Pull Request which uploads, not just the `rsshub.tar.zst` compressed docker image, but also a malicious `package.json` file with a script to run arbitrary code in the context of the privileged workflow. As of commit 64e00e7, this scenario has been addressed and the RSSHub repository is no longer vulnerable.
vuln_update.vuln_type: 拒绝服务,代码执行,信息泄露

vuln_update.vuln_name: Linux内核SMC UAF漏洞（CVE-2025-40139）
vuln_update.threat_category: 代码执行,拒绝服务,信息泄露
vuln_update.description:
在 Linux 内核中，以下漏洞已得到修复：

smc：在 smc_clc_prfx_set() 中使用 __sk_dst_get() 和 dst_dev_rcu()。

smc_clc_prfx_set() 在 connect() 期间被调用，且不在 RCU 或 RTNL 保护下。

使用 sk_dst_get(sk)->dev 可能会触发 UAF。

应在 kernel_getsockname() 之后，在 rcu_read_lock() 保护下使用 __sk_dst_get() 和 dev_dst_rcu()。

注意，smc_clc_prfx_set() 的返回值在调用方中未被使用。

顺带修改 smc_clc_prfx_set[46]_rcu() 的第一个参数，使其不再操作 dst。
vuln_update.description_en:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

smc: Use __sk_dst_get() and dst_dev_rcu() in in smc_clc_prfx_set().

smc_clc_prfx_set() is called during connect() and not under RCU
nor RTNL.

Using sk_dst_get(sk)->dev could trigger UAF.

Let's use __sk_dst_get() and dev_dst_rcu() under rcu_read_lock()
after kernel_getsockname().

Note that the returned value of smc_clc_prfx_set() is not used
in the caller.

While at it, we change the 1st arg of smc_clc_prfx_set[46]_rcu()
not to touch dst there.
vuln_update.vuln_type: 代码执行,拒绝服务,信息泄露

vuln_update.vuln_name: Linux exfat双重释放漏洞 (CVE-2025-38206)
vuln_update.threat_category: 代码执行,拒绝服务,信息泄露
vuln_update.description:
在 Linux 内核中，以下漏洞已得到解决：

exfat: 修复 delayed_free 中的双重释放

双重释放可能发生在以下路径中。

exfat_create_upcase_table()
        exfat_create_upcase_table() : 返回错误
        exfat_free_upcase_table() : 释放 ->vol_utbl
        exfat_load_default_upcase_table : 返回错误
     exfat_kill_sb()
           delayed_free()
                  exfat_free_upcase_table() <--------- 双重释放
此补丁集在释放后将 ->vol_util 设置为 NULL。
vuln_update.description_en:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

exfat: fix double free in delayed_free

The double free could happen in the following path.

exfat_create_upcase_table()
        exfat_create_upcase_table() : return error
        exfat_free_upcase_table() : free ->vol_utbl
        exfat_load_default_upcase_table : return error
     exfat_kill_sb()
           delayed_free()
                  exfat_free_upcase_table() <--------- double free
This patch set ->vol_util as NULL after freeing it.

vuln_update.description: JupyterLab 扩展模板是一个 JupyterLab 扩展的 `copier` 模板。使用此模板并带有 `test` 选项创建的仓库包括 `update-integration-tests.yml` 工作流，该工作流存在 RCE 漏洞。我们敦促在 GitHub 上托管代码的扩展作者将模板升级到最新版本。对 `update-integration-tests.yml` 进行了更改的用户，接受此文件的覆盖，并稍后重新应用您的更改。用户可能希望在升级过程中暂时禁用 GitHub Actions，因为操作可能会使用在创建拉取请求时 `main` 分支的版本运行。从模板版本 4.3.0 之前升级的用户可能希望暂时忽略对发布工作流的提议更改，因为它需要额外的配置。
vuln_update.description_en: JupyterLab extension template is a  `copier` template for JupyterLab extensions. Repositories created using this template with `test` option include `update-integration-tests.yml` workflow which has an RCE vulnerability. Extension authors hosting their code on GitHub are urged to upgrade the template to the latest version. vuln_update.vuln_name: urllib3 重定向解压缩漏洞 (CVE-2026-21441)
vuln_update.technical_category: 高度压缩数据的不当处理
vuln_update.description: urllib3 是一个用于 Python 的 HTTP 客户端库。urllib3 的流式 API 旨在通过以块的形式读取内容，而不是一次性将整个响应体加载到内存中，从而高效处理大型 HTTP 响应。urllib3 可以根据 HTTP `Content-Encoding` 头部执行解码或解压缩（例如 `gzip`、`deflate`、`br` 或 `zstd`）。在使用流式 API 时，该库仅解压缩必要的字节，从而实现部分内容的消费。从 1.22 版本开始，直到 2.6.3 版本之前，对于 HTTP 重定向响应，该库会读取整个响应体以耗尽连接并不必要的解压缩内容。这种解压缩甚至在调用任何读取方法之前就已发生，且配置的读取限制无法限制解压缩数据的量。因此，不存在针对解压缩炸弹的防护措施。恶意服务器可利用此问题在客户端触发过度的资源消耗。当应用程序和库通过设置 `preload_content=False` 从不受信任的源流式传输内容，但未禁用重定向时，会受到影响。用户应升级到至少 urllib3 v2.6.3 版本，该版本在 `preload_content=False` 时不会解码重定向响应的内容。如果无法立即升级，请通过将请求的 `redirect=False` 设置为禁用重定向。
vuln_update.description_en: urllib3 is an HTTP client library for Python. urllib3's streaming API is designed for the efficient handling of large HTTP responses by reading the content in chunks, rather than loading the entire response body into memory at once. urllib3 can perform decoding or decompression based on the HTTP `Content-Encoding` header (e.g., `gzip`, `deflate`, `br`, or `zstd`). When using the streaming API, the library decompresses only the necessary bytes, enabling partial content consumption. Starting in version 1.22 and prior to version 2.6.3, for HTTP redirect responses, the library would read the entire response body to drain the connection and decompress the content unnecessarily. This decompression occurred even before any read methods were called, and configured read limits did not restrict the amount of decompressed data. As a result, there was no safeguard against decompression bombs. A malicious server could exploit this to trigger excessive resource consumption on the client. Applications and libraries are affected when they stream content from untrusted sources by setting `preload_content=False` when they do not disable redirects. Users should upgrade to at least urllib3 v2.6.3, in which the library does not decode content of redirect responses when `preload_content=False`. If upgrading is not immediately possible, disable redirects by setting `redirect=False` for requests to untrusted source.

vuln_update.vuln_name: Linux内核SMC UAF漏洞(CVE-2025-40168)
vuln_update.threat_category: 代码执行,拒绝服务,信息泄露
vuln_update.description:
在 Linux 内核中，以下漏洞已得到修复：

smc：在 smc_clc_prfx_match() 中使用 __sk_dst_get() 和 dst_dev_rcu()。

smc_clc_prfx_match() 从 smc_listen_work() 调用，且不在 RCU 或 RTNL 保护下。

使用 sk_dst_get(sk)->dev 可能触发 UAF。

应使用 __sk_dst_get() 和 dst_dev_rcu()。

注意，smc_clc_prfx_match() 的返回值在调用方中未被使用。
vuln_update.description_en:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

smc: Use __sk_dst_get() and dst_dev_rcu() in smc_clc_prfx_match().

smc_clc_prfx_match() is called from smc_listen_work() and
not under RCU nor RTNL.

Using sk_dst_get(sk)->dev could trigger UAF.

Let's use __sk_dst_get() and dst_dev_rcu().

Note that the returned value of smc_clc_prfx_match() is not
used in the caller.
vuln_update.vuln_type: 代码执行,拒绝服务,信息泄露

vuln_update.vuln_name: Linux内核SMC UAF漏洞（CVE-2025-40064）
vuln_update.threat_category: 代码执行,拒绝服务,信息泄露
vuln_update.description:
在 Linux 内核中，以下漏洞已得到修复：

smc：修复 __pnet_find_base_ndev() 中的 use-after-free 问题。

syzbot 报告了在 __pnet_find_base_ndev() 中对 net_device 的 use-after-free 问题，该函数在 connect() 期间被调用。[0]

smc_pnet_find_ism_resource() 获取 sk_dst_get(sk)->dev 并传递给 pnet_find_base_ndev()，其中持有 RTNL。随后，在 __pnet_find_base_ndev() 中首次使用 dev 时发生了 UAF。

这意味着在 pnet_find_base_ndev() 中获取 RTNL 之前，dev 已经被释放。

当 dev 正在被释放时，dst->dev 可能被替换为 blackhole_netdev，且 dst 对 dev 的引用计数将被释放。

我们必须在调用 smc_pnet_find_ism_resource() 之前持有 dev 的引用计数。

此外，smc_pnet_find_roce_resource() 也存在相同的问题。

在这两个函数中，应使用 __sk_dst_get() 和 dst_dev_rcu()。

vuln_update.description_en:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

smc: Fix use-after-free in __pnet_find_base_ndev().

syzbot reported use-after-free of net_device in __pnet_find_base_ndev(),
which was called during connect(). [0]

smc_pnet_find_ism_resource() fetches sk_dst_get(sk)->dev and passes
down to pnet_find_base_ndev(), where RTNL is held.  Then, UAF happened
at __pnet_find_base_ndev() when the dev is first used.

This means dev had already been freed before acquiring RTNL in
pnet_find_base_ndev().

While dev is going away, dst->dev could be swapped with blackhole_netdev,
and the dev's refcnt by dst will be released.

We must hold dev's refcnt before calling smc_pnet_find_ism_resource().

Also, smc_pnet_find_roce_resource() has the same problem.

Let's use __sk_dst_get() and dst_dev_rcu() in the two functions.

vuln_update.vuln_name: Linux 拒绝服务漏洞(CVE-2024-27010)
vuln_update.description:
Linux 内核中net/sched：修复设备递归上的镜像死锁。当在有类出口队列规定上使用镜像操作并且数据包被镜像或重定向到自身时，我们会遇到队列规定锁死锁。
成功利用该漏洞可能造成信息泄露、拒绝服务等危害。
vuln_update.description_en:
In the Linux kernel, net/sched: A fix for the recursive mirroring deadlock on devices. When mirroring operations are used with classful egress queues and packets are mirrored or redirected to themselves, we encounter a deadlock in the queue rules lock.
Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could lead to information disclosure, denial of service, and other hazards.

vuln_update.vuln_name: Cacti SQL注入漏洞(CVE-2023-39361)
vuln_update.description: Cacti 是一个开源操作监控和故障管理框架。 受影响的版本会受到在 graph_view.php 中发现的 SQL 注入的影响。 由于默认情况下访客用户无需身份验证即可访问 graph_view.php，因此如果在启用状态下使用访客用户，则可能会造成重大损害。 攻击者可能会利用此漏洞，并有可能进行篡夺管理权限或远程执行代码等操作。 此问题已在版本 1.2.25 中得到解决。 建议用户升级。 此漏洞没有已知的解决方法。
vuln_update.description_en: Cacti is an open source operations monitoring and fault management framework. Affected versions are affected by SQL injection found in graph_view.php. Since, by default, guest users can access graph_view.php without authentication, significant damage can be caused if guest users are used in the enabled state. An attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability and potentially perform actions such as usurp administrative privileges or remotely execute code. This issue has been resolved in version 1.2.25. Users are advised to upgrade. There are no known workarounds for this vulnerability.

vuln_update.vuln_name: Linux Kernel 释放后重用漏洞(CVE-2022-4696)
vuln_update.vuln_name_en: Linux Kernel reuse vulnerability after free (CVE-2022-4696)
vuln_update.threat_category: 拒绝服务,信息泄漏,权限提升
vuln_update.description: Linux内核存在释放后使用漏洞。如果 IORING_OP_SPLICE 缺少 IO_WQ_WORK_FILES 标志，这表明该操作不会使用 current->nsproxy，因此它的引用计数器不会增加。这个假设并不总是正确的，因为在特定文件上调用 io_splice 将调用 get_uts 函数，该函数将使用 current->nsproxy 导致以后无效地减少其引用计数器，从而导致释放后使用漏洞。
vuln_update.description_en: The Linux kernel has a Use After Free vulnerability. If IORING_OP_SPLICE lacks the IO_WQ_WORK_FILES flag, this suggests that the operation does not use current->nsproxy, so its reference counter does not increase. This assumption is not always true, because calling io_splice on a specific file will call the get_uts function, which will use current->nsproxy to cause its reference counter to be later ineffectively reduced, resulting in a Use After Free vulnerability.
vuln_update.vuln_type: 拒绝服务,信息泄漏,权限提升

vuln_update.description_en: An issue was discovered in LibreNMS 1.65. A remote authenticated attacker with normal privileges can extract all the information from the LibreNMS database via a SQL injection in the sort parameter in the /ajax_table.php API endpoint. vuln_update.description: zlib 版本 1.3.1.2 及之前版本在 untgz 工具中存在全局缓冲区溢出漏洞。TGZfname() 函数使用未限定长度的 strcpy() 调用，将攻击者提供的归档文件名从 argv[] 复制到固定大小的 1024 字节静态全局缓冲区中，且未进行长度验证。提供超过 1024 字节的归档文件名会导致越界写入，可能引发内存损坏、拒绝服务，甚至在特定编译器、构建标志、架构和内存布局下导致代码执行。该溢出发生在任何归档文件解析或验证之前。
vuln_update.description_en: zlib versions up to and including 1.3.1.2 contain a global buffer overflow in the untgz utility. The TGZfname() function copies an attacker-supplied archive name from argv[] into a fixed-size 1024-byte static global buffer using an unbounded strcpy() call without length validation. Supplying an archive name longer than 1024 bytes results in an out-of-bounds write that can lead to memory corruption, denial of service, and potentially code execution depending on compiler, build flags, architecture, and memory layout. The overflow occurs prior to any archive parsing or validation.

vuln_update.vuln_name: Cisco IOS XE CLI 特权提升漏洞 (CVE-2025-20197)
vuln_update.vuln_name_en: Cisco IOS XE CLI Privilege Escalation Vulnerability (CVE-2025-20197)
vuln_update.threat_category: 代码执行,拒绝服务,信息泄露
vuln_update.description:
Cisco IOS XE Software 的 CLI 中存在一个漏洞，允许具有特权级别 15 的已认证本地攻击者将特权提升到受影响设备底层操作系统的 root 级别。
`
此漏洞是由于处理特定配置命令时输入验证不足。攻击者可以通过在特定配置命令中包含精心构造的输入来利用此漏洞。成功的利用可以允许攻击者将特权提升到受影响设备底层操作系统的 root 级别。此公告的安全影响评级 (SIR) 已提高到高，因为攻击者可以获得受影响设备底层操作系统的访问权限并执行可能未被检测到的操作。
`
注意：攻击者必须具有进入受影响设备配置模式的权限。这通常称为特权级别 15。
vuln_update.description_en:
A vulnerability in the CLI of Cisco IOS XE Software could allow an authenticated, local attacker with privilege level 15 to elevate privileges to root on the underlying operating system of an affected device.
 This vulnerability is due to insufficient input validation when processing specific configuration commands. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by including crafted input in specific configuration commands. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to elevate privileges to root on the underlying operating system of an affected device. The security impact rating (SIR) of this advisory has been raised to High because an attacker could gain access to the underlying operating system of the affected device and perform potentially undetected actions.
 Note: The attacker must have privileges to enter configuration mode on the affected device. This is usually referred to as privilege level 15.
vuln_update.vuln_type: 代码执行,拒绝服务,信息泄露

vuln_update.vuln_name: go-libp2p 拒绝服务漏洞(CVE-2023-39533)
vuln_update.description: go-libp2p 是 libp2p 网络堆栈的 Go 实现。 在版本 0.27.8、0.28.2 和 0.29.1 之前，恶意对等方可以使用大型 RSA 密钥来运行资源耗尽攻击，并强制节点花时间对大型密钥进行签名验证。 该漏洞存在于 go-libp2p 的 core/crypto 模块中，可能在噪声握手和 libp2p x509 扩展验证步骤期间发生。 为了防止这种攻击，go-libp2p 版本 0.27.8、0.28.2 和 0.29.1 将 RSA 密钥限制为 <= 8192 位。 为了保护应用程序，有必要更新到这些补丁版本并使用 1.20.7 或 1.19.12 中更新的 Go 编译器。 此问题没有已知的解决方法。
vuln_update.description_en: go-libp2p is a Go implementation of the libp2P network stack. Prior to versions 0.27.8, 0.28.2, and 0.29.1, a malicious peer could use a large RSA key to run a resource exhaustion attack and force nodes to spend time signature verification on the large key. The vulnerability exists in the core/crypto module of go-libp2p and could occur during the noisy handshake and the validation step of the libp2P x509 extension. To prevent this attack, go-libp2p versions 0.27.8, 0.28.2, and 0.29.1 limit RSA keys to < 8192 bits. To protect the application, it is necessary to update to these patched versions and use the Go compiler updated in 1.20.7 or 1.19.12. There are no known workarounds for this issue.

vuln_update.vuln_name: VMware Spring Batch 代码问题漏洞(CVE-2020-5411)
vuln_update.description: 当配置为启用 default typing 时，Jackson 存在反序列化漏洞，该漏洞可导致任意代码执行。Spring Batch 将启用全局默认类型的 Jackson 配置为启用，这意味着通过以下漏洞利用，只要满足以下所有条件就可以执行任意代码：1、利用Spring Batch 的 Jackson支持来序列化 job's ExecutionContext。2、恶意用户获得对 JobRepository 使用的数据存储的写访问权限（要反序列化的数据存储在该数据存储中）。为了防止此类攻击，Jackson 防止反序列化一系列不受信任的 gadget。当 default typing 启用时，Spring Batch 应积极主动地阻止未知的“反序列化 gadgets”。
vuln_update.description_en: When configured to enable default typing, Jackson has a deserialization vulnerability that can lead to arbitrary code execution. SpringBatch will enable the global default type of Jackson configuration to enable, which means that arbitrary code can be executed through the following vulnerabilities, provided that all of the conditions below are met: 1. Use Spring Batch's Jackson support to serialize job's ExecutionContext. The malicious user obtains written access to the data storage used by JobRepository (where the data to be deserialized is stored). To prevent such attacks, Jackson prevents the deserialization of a series of untrusted gadgets. When default typing is enabled, Spring Batch should actively block unknown "anti-serialization gadgets."

vuln_update.vuln_name: Flowise代码执行漏洞(CVE-2025-59528)
vuln_update.description: Flowise 是一个用于构建自定义大语言模型流程的拖拽式用户界面。在版本 3.0.5 中，Flowise 存在远程代码执行漏洞。CustomMCP 节点允许用户输入连接到外部 MCP 服务器的配置设置。该节点会解析用户提供的 mcpServerConfig 字符串以构建 MCP 服务器配置。然而，在此过程中，它会未经任何安全验证地执行 JavaScript 代码。具体而言，在 convertToValidJSONString 函数内部，用户输入被直接传递给 Function() 构造函数，该构造函数会评估并执行输入的 JavaScript 代码。由于此操作以完整的 Node.js 运行时权限运行，因此可以访问诸如 child_process 和 fs 等危险模块。此问题已在版本 3.0.6 中修复。
vuln_update.description_en: Flowise is a drag & drop user interface to build a customized large language model flow. In version 3.0.5, Flowise is vulnerable to remote code execution. The CustomMCP node allows users to input configuration settings for connecting to an external MCP server. This node parses the user-provided mcpServerConfig string to build the MCP server configuration. However, during this process, it executes JavaScript code without any security validation. Specifically, inside the convertToValidJSONString function, user input is directly passed to the Function() constructor, which evaluates and executes the input as JavaScript code. Since this runs with full Node.js runtime privileges, it can access dangerous modules such as child_process and fs. This issue has been patched in version 3.0.6.

vuln_update.vuln_name: Asterisk权限提升漏洞(CVE-2024-42365)
vuln_update.threat_category: 权限提升,安全特性绕过
vuln_update.technical_category: 特权定义了不安全动作,访问控制粒度不足
vuln_update.description: Asterisk 是一个开源的私有分支交换机（PBX）和电话工具包。在 Asterisk 版本 18.24.2、20.9.2 和 21.4.2 以及经过认证的 Asterisk 版本 18.9-cert11 和 20.7-cert2 之前，具有 `write=originate` 权限的 AMI 用户可以更改 `/etc/asterisk/` 目录中的所有配置文件。这是因为他们能够 curl 远程文件并将它们写入磁盘，但也可以使用 `SET` 应用程序内部的 `FILE` 函数追加到现有文件。这个问题可能导致权限提升、远程代码执行和/或带有任意协议的盲服务器端请求伪造。Asterisk 版本 18.24.2、20.9.2 和 21.4.2 以及经过认证的 Asterisk 版本 18.9-cert11 和 20.7-cert2 包含了这个问题的修复。
vuln_update.description_en: Asterisk is an open source private branch exchange (PBX) and telephony toolkit. Prior to asterisk versions 18.24.2, 20.9.2, and 21.4.2 and certified-asterisk versions 18.9-cert11 and 20.7-cert2, an AMI user with `write=originate` may change all configuration files in the `/etc/asterisk/` directory. This occurs because they are able to curl remote files and write them to disk, but are also able to append to existing files using the `FILE` function inside the `SET` application. This issue may result in privilege escalation, remote code execution and/or blind server-side request forgery with arbitrary protocol. Asterisk versions 18.24.2, 20.9.2, and 21.4.2 and certified-asterisk versions 18.9-cert11 and 20.7-cert2 contain a fix for this issue.
vuln_update.vuln_type: 权限提升,安全特性绕过

vuln_update.vuln_name: glib代码执行漏洞(CVE-2025-13601)
vuln_update.threat_category: 代码执行, 拒绝服务
vuln_update.description: 在 glib 中发现了一个基于堆的缓冲区溢出问题，问题出在 g_escape_uri_string() 函数中对缓冲区大小的错误计算。如果需要转义的字符串包含大量不被接受的字符（这些字符需要被转义），则转义后字符串长度的计算可能会溢出，导致可能向新分配的字符串末尾之外进行写入。
vuln_update.description_en: A heap-based buffer overflow problem was found in glib through an incorrect calculation of buffer size in the g_escape_uri_string() function. If the string to escape contains a very large number of unacceptable characters (which would need escaping), the calculation of the length of the escaped string could overflow, leading to a potential write off the end of the newly allocated string.
vuln_update.vuln_type: 代码执行, 拒绝服务

vuln_update.vuln_name: libxslt代码执行漏洞(CVE-2025-7425)
vuln_update.description: 在 libxslt 中发现了一个漏洞，其中属性类型 `atype` 和标志 `flags` 以一种破坏内部内存管理的方式被修改。当 XSLT 函数（如 `key()` 过程）导致树片段时，这种破坏会阻止 ID 属性的正确清理。因此，系统可能会访问已释放的内存，导致崩溃或使攻击者能够触发堆损坏。
vuln_update.description_en: A flaw was found in libxslt where the attribute type, atype, flags are modified in a way that corrupts internal memory management. When XSLT functions, such as the key() process, result in tree fragments, this corruption prevents the proper cleanup of ID attributes. As a result, the system may access freed memory, causing crashes or enabling attackers to trigger heap corruption.

vuln_update.vuln_name: containers buildah安全漏洞(CVE-2024-11218)
vuln_update.threat_category: 代码执行,拒绝服务,信息泄露
vuln_update.description:
### 影响
通过在Containerfiles中的RUN指令中谨慎使用`--mount`标志，以及使用多阶段构建和并发执行构建阶段（例如，使用`--jobs` CLI标志）或多个独立的但并发执行的构建，恶意Containerfile可以用来将构建主机的内容暴露给使用RUN指令执行的命令。这可以用来使用执行构建的进程的权限读取或写入内容。当该进程是一个root拥有的podman系统服务，并且是为无特权用户提供使用时，这包括读取和写入客户端不应该被允许读取和写入的内容的能力，包括在无特权用户稍后可以访问的位置的setuid可执行文件。

### 补丁
补丁已经合并到主分支，并将添加到即将发布的release-1.38、release-1.37、release-1.35和release-1.33分支中。

这解决了一些Jira卡片，但主要是https://issues.redhat.com/browse/RHEL-67616和https://issues.redhat.com/browse/RHEL-67618，然后被vendored到Podman中，并回传到旧分支。

### 解决方案
在启用了强制访问控制的系统上，应该限制执行构建的进程的访问权限。
vuln_update.description_en:
### Impact
With careful use of the `--mount` flag in RUN instructions in Containerfiles, and by using either multi-stage builds with use of concurrently-executing build stages (e.g., using the `--jobs` CLI flag) or multiple separate but concurrently-executing builds, a malicious Containerfile can be used to expose content from the build host to the command being run using the RUN instruction.  This can be used to read or write contents using the privileges of the process which is performing the build.  When that process is a root-owned podman system service which is provided for use by unprivileged users, this includes the ability to read and write contents which the client should not be allowed to read and write, including setuid executables in locations where they can be later accessed by unprivileged users.

### Patches
Patches have been merged to the main branch, and will be added to upcoming releases on the release-1.38, release-1.37, release-1.35, and release-1.33 branches.

This addressed a number of Jira cards, but primarily https://issues.redhat.com/browse/RHEL-67616 and https://issues.redhat.com/browse/RHEL-67618, which were then vendored into Podman and backported into olde rbranches.

### Workarounds
Mandatory access controls should limit the access of the process performing the build, on systems where they are enabled.

vuln_update.vuln_name: Linux内核IPv4内存泄漏漏洞（CVE-2023-53995）
vuln_update.vuln_name_en: Linux kernel IPv4 memory leak vulnerability (CVE-2023-53995)
vuln_update.description:
在 Linux 内核中，以下漏洞已得到修复：

net: ipv4: 修复 __inet_del_ifa() 中的一个内存泄漏问题

在进行模糊测试时，我收到了以下警告：
unregister_netdevice: 等待 bond0 变为空闲。使用计数 = 2

可通过以下步骤复现：

ip link add bond0 type bond
sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.bond0.promote_secondaries=1
ip addr add 4.117.174.103/0 scope 0x40 dev bond0
ip addr add 192.168.100.111/255.255.255.254 scope 0 dev bond0
ip addr add 0.0.0.4/0 scope 0x40 secondary dev bond0
ip addr del 4.117.174.103/0 scope 0x40 dev bond0
ip link delete bond0 type bond

在此复现测试用例中，__inet_del_ifa() 中发现了一个错误的 'last_prim'，导致次级地址（0.0.0.4/0 scope 0x40）丢失。次级地址的内存被泄漏，in_device 和 net_device 的引用也被泄漏。

修复此问题：
从被删除 IP 的位置开始查找 'last_prim'，并将提升的 IP 插入到 'last_prim' 的位置。
vuln_update.description_en:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

net: ipv4: fix one memleak in __inet_del_ifa()

I got the below warning when do fuzzing test:
unregister_netdevice: waiting for bond0 to become free. Usage count = 2

It can be repoduced via:

ip link add bond0 type bond
sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.bond0.promote_secondaries=1
ip addr add 4.117.174.103/0 scope 0x40 dev bond0
ip addr add 192.168.100.111/255.255.255.254 scope 0 dev bond0
ip addr add 0.0.0.4/0 scope 0x40 secondary dev bond0
ip addr del 4.117.174.103/0 scope 0x40 dev bond0
ip link delete bond0 type bond

In this reproduction test case, an incorrect 'last_prim' is found in
__inet_del_ifa(), as a result, the secondary address(0.0.0.4/0 scope 0x40)
is lost. The memory of the secondary address is leaked and the reference of
in_device and net_device is leaked.

Fix this problem:
Look for 'last_prim' starting at location of the deleted IP and inserting
the promoted IP into the location of 'last_prim'.

vuln_update.vuln_name: Parse Server 权限提升漏洞（CVE-2025-67727）
vuln_update.vuln_name_en: Privilege escalation vulnerability in Parse Server (CVE-2025-67727)
vuln_update.technical_category: 代码注入,特权管理不当
vuln_update.description: Parse Server 是一个开源后端，可部署到任何运行 Node.js 的基础设施上。在 8.6.0-alpha.2 版本之前，GitHub CI 工作流以一种授予 GitHub Actions 工作流提升权限的方式被触发，使其能够访问工作流中定义的 GitHub 秘密和写入权限。来自分叉或生命周期脚本的代码可能被包含在内。仅受影响的是仓库的 CI/CD 基础设施，包括任何启用了 GitHub Actions 的公共 GitHub 分叉。此问题已在 8.6.0-alpha.2 版本以及提交 6b9f896 和 e3d27fe 中修复。
vuln_update.description_en: Parse Server is an open source backend that can be deployed to any infrastructure that runs Node.js. In versions prior to 8.6.0-alpha.2, a GitHub CI workflow is triggered in a way that grants the GitHub Actions workflow elevated permissions, giving it access to GitHub secrets and write permissions which are defined in the workflow. Code from a fork or lifecycle scripts is potentially included. Only the repository's CI/CD infrastructure is affected, including any public GitHub forks with GitHub Actions enabled. This issue is fixed version 8.6.0-alpha.2 and commits 6b9f896 and e3d27fe.

vuln_update.vuln_name: libxml2代码执行漏洞(CVE-2025-49796)
vuln_update.description: 在 libxml2 中发现了一个漏洞。处理来自输入 XML 文件的某些 sch:name 元素可能会触发内存损坏问题。此漏洞允许攻击者制作恶意 XML 输入文件，导致 libxml 崩溃，从而造成拒绝服务或其他可能的未定义行为，因为内存中的敏感数据被破坏。
vuln_update.description_en: A vulnerability was found in libxml2. Processing certain sch:name elements from the input XML file can trigger a memory corruption issue. This flaw allows an attacker to craft a malicious XML input file that can lead libxml to crash, resulting in a denial of service or other possible undefined behavior due to sensitive data being corrupted in memory.

vuln_update.vuln_name: Red Hat libxml2拒绝服务漏洞(CVE-2025-49794)
vuln_update.vuln_name_en: Red Hat libxml2 denial of service vulnerability (CVE-2025-49794)
vuln_update.description: 一个 use-after-free 漏洞在 libxml2 中被发现。此问题发生在解析 XPath 元素时，在某些情况下，当 XML schematron 包含 `<sch:name path="..."/>` schema 元素时。此漏洞允许恶意行为者构造恶意的 XML 文档，用作 libxml 的输入，导致程序崩溃或出现其他可能的未定义行为。
vuln_update.description_en: A use-after-free vulnerability was found in libxml2. This issue occurs when parsing XPath elements under certain circumstances when the XML schematron has the <sch:name path="..."/> schema elements. This flaw allows a malicious actor to craft a malicious XML document used as input for libxml, resulting in the program's crash using libxml or other possible undefined behaviors.

vuln_update.vuln_name: phpgt/Dom信息泄露漏洞(CVE-2025-46820)
vuln_update.threat_category: 信息泄露,身份认证绕过
vuln_update.technical_category: 明文存储数据,信息暴露,凭据保护不足,敏感信息泄露
vuln_update.description: phpgt/Dom 提供对现代 DOM API 的访问。在 4.1.8 之前的 phpgt/Dom 版本中，Dom 工作流运行工件中会暴露 GITHUB_TOKEN。ci.yml 工作流文件使用 actions/upload-artifact@v4 上传构建工件。此工件是当前目录的 zip 文件，其中包含自动生成的 .git/config 文件，该文件包含运行的 GITHUB_TOKEN。由于工件可以在工作流结束前下载，因此在几秒钟内，攻击者可以从工件中提取令牌，并使用 GitHub API 推送恶意代码或重写仓库中的发布提交。任何下游用户都可能受到影响，但令牌仅在工作流运行期间有效，限制了可以进行利用的时间。版本 4.1.8 修复了此问题。
vuln_update.description_en: phpgt/Dom provides access to modern DOM APIs. Versions of phpgt/Dom prior to 4.1.8 expose the GITHUB_TOKEN in the Dom workflow run artifact. The ci.yml workflow file uses actions/upload-artifact@v4 to upload the build artifact. This artifact is a zip of the current directory, which includes the automatically generated .git/config file containing the run's GITHUB_TOKEN. Seeing as the artifact can be downloaded prior to the end of the workflow, there is a few seconds where an attacker can extract the token from the artifact and use it with the GitHub API to push malicious code or rewrite release commits in your repository. Any downstream user of the repository may be affected, but the token should only be valid for the duration of the workflow run, limiting the time during which exploitation could occur. Version 4.1.8 fixes the issue.
vuln_update.vuln_type: 信息泄露,身份认证绕过

vuln_update.vuln_name: z80pack信息泄露漏洞(CVE-2025-32953)
vuln_update.description: z80pack 是一个成熟的多平台 8080 和 Z80 CPU 模拟器。在版本 1.38 及之前，`makefile-ubuntu.yml` 工作流文件使用 `actions/upload-artifact@v4` 上传 `z80pack-ubuntu` 构建产物。此构建产物是当前目录的 zip 文件，其中包含自动生成的 `.git/config` 文件，该文件包含运行的 GITHUB_TOKEN。由于在工作流结束之前可以下载该构建产物，因此在几秒钟内攻击者可以从中提取令牌并使用 Github API 推送恶意代码或重写仓库中的发布提交。此问题已在提交 bd95916 中修复。
vuln_update.description_en: z80pack is a mature emulator of multiple platforms with 8080 and Z80 CPU. In version 1.38 and prior, the `makefile-ubuntu.yml` workflow file uses `actions/upload-artifact@v4` to upload the `z80pack-ubuntu` artifact. This artifact is a zip of the current directory, which includes the automatically generated `.git/config` file containing the run's GITHUB_TOKEN. Seeing as the artifact can be downloaded prior to the end of the workflow, there is a few seconds where an attacker can extract the token from the artifact and use it with the Github API to push malicious code or rewrite release commits in your repository. This issue has been fixed in commit bd95916.

vuln_update.vuln_name: Red Hat 多款产品拒绝服务漏洞(CVE-2024-12085)
vuln_update.vuln_name_en: Red Hat Multiple Products Denial of Service Vulnerability (CVE-2024-12085)
vuln_update.threat_category: 信息泄露,代码执行,拒绝服务
vuln_update.description: 在 rsync 守护进程中发现了一个漏洞，该漏洞可能在 rsync 比较文件校验和时被触发。这个漏洞允许攻击者操纵校验和长度（s2length），导致在校验和与未初始化的内存之间进行比较，并一次泄露一个字节的未初始化堆栈数据。
vuln_update.description_en: A flaw was found in the rsync daemon which could be triggered when rsync compares file checksums. This flaw allows an attacker to manipulate the checksum length (s2length) to cause a comparison between a checksum and uninitialized memory and leak one byte of uninitialized stack data at a time.
