vuln_update.vuln_name: Kiwi TCMS 操作系统命令注入漏洞(CVE-2023-30628)
vuln_update.vuln_name_en: Kiwi TCMS OS Command Injection Vulnerability (CVE-2023-30628)
vuln_update.description:
Kiwi TCMS是Kiwi TCMS开源的一个用于手动和自动测试的领先开源测试管理系统。 
Kiwi TCMS存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，该漏洞源于使用了不受信任的字段导致存在命令注入漏洞。受影响的产品和版本：kiwitcms/Kiwi 12.2及之前版本， kiwitcms/enterprise 12.2及之前版本。
vuln_update.description_en:
Kiwi TCMS is a leading open source test management system for manual and automated testing open sourced by Kiwi TC MS.
Kiwi TCMS has an operating system command injection vulnerability, which is caused by the use of untrusted fields, which leads to a commands injection vulnerability. Affected products and versions: kiwitcms/Kiwi 12.2 and earlier versions, kiwitcams/enterprise 12.2 and previous versions.

vuln_update.vuln_name: Versa Director 命令注入漏洞(CVE-2019-25029)
vuln_update.description: 在Versa Director中，命令注入是一种攻击，其目标是通过一个易受攻击的应用程序在主机操作系统上执行任意命令。 当应用程序将不安全的用户提供的数据(表单、cookie、HTTP头等)传递到系统外壳时，注入命令攻击是可能的。 在这种攻击中，攻击者提供的操作系统命令通常以易受攻击的应用程序的权限执行。 注入命令攻击很大程度上是由于输入验证不足。
vuln_update.description_en: In Versa Director, command injection is an attack whose objective is to execute arbitrary commands on the host operating system through an attackable application. An injection command attack is possible when an application passes data (form, cookie, HTTP, etc.) provided by an unsecure user to the system's shell. In such attacks, the operating system commands provided by the attacker are usually executed with the permission of an attackable application. Injection command attacks are largely due to insufficient input validation.

vuln_update.vuln_name: Versa Analytics 安全漏洞(CVE-2018-16497)
vuln_update.description: 在Versa Analytics中，cron作业用于通过在服务器上执行特定日期和时间的命令来调度任务。 如果作业作为用户根运行,则存在潜在的权限升级漏洞。 在这种情况下,作业以root身份运行脚本,该脚本可由作为versa组成员的用户写入。
vuln_update.description_en: In Versa Analytics, the cron job is used to schedule tasks by executing commands for specific dates and times on the server. If the job is running as a user root, there is a potential permission upgrade vulnerability. In this case, the job runs a script in root identity that can be written by a user who is a member of the versa group.

vuln_update.vuln_name: Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) 和 Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) 软件 VPN 服务器远程代码执行漏洞(CVE-2025-20333)
vuln_update.vuln_name_en: Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) Software VPN Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (CVE-2025-20333)
vuln_update.description: 思科自适应安全应用设备（ASA）软件和思科安全防火墙威胁防御（FTD）软件是广泛部署的网络防火墙解决方案，提供VPN等网络安全功能。该漏洞产生于VPN Web服务器中对用户输入的HTTP(S)请求验证不当。经过身份验证的远程攻击者可以通过发送精心构造的HTTP请求来利用此漏洞，成功利用可能导致攻击者以root权限执行任意代码，可能导致受影响设备的完全妥协。
vuln_update.description_en: Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) Software and Cisco Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) Software are widely deployed network firewall solutions providing cybersecurity features such as VPN. The vulnerability arises from improper validation of user input in the VPN web server for HTTP(S) requests. Authenticated remote attackers can exploit this vulnerability by sending carefully crafted HTTP requests. Successful exploitation may allow the attacker to execute arbitrary code with root privileges, potentially leading to complete compromise of the affected device.

vuln_update.vuln_name: React Server Components 远程代码执行漏洞(CVE-2025-55182)
vuln_update.vuln_name_en: React Server Components Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (CVE-2025-55182)
vuln_update.technical_category: CWE-502 反序列化缺陷:不安全的反序列化
vuln_update.description:
React Server Components是一个用于构建服务器端组件的框架，支持多种包如react-server-dom-parcel、react-server-dom-turbopack和react-server-dom-webpack。
此漏洞主要影响 react-server-dom-webpack 的 Server Actions 功能。由于在解析客户端提交的表单时缺少安全校验，攻击者可通过构造恶意表单请求，直接调用 Node.js 内置模块，从而在服务器上执行任意系统命令、读写任意文件，甚至完全接管服务
vuln_update.description_en:
React Server Components is a framework for building server-side components, supporting various packages such as react-server-dom-parcel, react-server-dom-turbopack, and react-server-dom-webpack.
This vulnerability primarily affects the Server Actions feature of react-server-dom-webpack. Due to the lack of security validation when parsing forms submitted by clients, attackers can construct malicious form requests to directly invoke Node.js built-in modules, thereby executing arbitrary system commands, reading and writing arbitrary files on the server, and even completely taking over the service.

vuln_update.vuln_name: Langflow 代码验证接口远程代码执行漏洞(CVE-2025-3248)
vuln_update.vuln_name_en: Langflow Code Validation Interface Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (CVE-2025-3248)
vuln_update.technical_category: 关键功能的认证机制缺失,代码注入
vuln_update.description: Langflow是一个人工智能构建器，用于构建和部署机器学习模型。该产品支持代码验证功能。在1.3.0之前的版本中，/api/v1/validate/code端点存在代码注入漏洞。由于缺少适当的身份验证措施，远程且未经身份验证的攻击者可以通过发送精心设计的HTTP请求来执行任意代码。
vuln_update.description_en: Langflow is an AI builder for building and deploying machine learning models. The product supports code verification functions. In versions prior to 1.3.0 there is a Code Injection vulnerability in the /api/v1/validate/code endpoint. Due to the lack of proper authentication measures, remote and unauthenticated attackers can execute arbitrary code by sending crafted HTTP requests.

vuln_update.vuln_name: vsftpd操作系统命令注入漏洞(CVE-2011-2523)
vuln_update.vuln_name_en: vsftpd operating system command injection vulnerability(CVE-2011-2523)
vuln_update.description: 在vsftpd 2.3.4（文件传输软件）中发现了一个漏洞，并被归类为非常关键的。此漏洞影响组件Service Port 6200的未知代码块。适当的tcp/6200防火墙可以解决这个问题。
vuln_update.description_en: A vulnerability was found in vsftpd 2.3.4, which is classified as critical. The vulnerabilities affect the unknown code block of the component Service Port 6200. An appropriate tcp/6200 firewall can solve this problem.

vuln_update.vuln_name: Jenkins任意文件读取漏洞(CVE-2024-23897)
vuln_update.description:
Jenkins 有一个内置的命令行界面（CLI），可从脚本或 shell 环境访问 Jenkins。处理 CLI 命令时， Jenkins 使用args4j库解析 Jenkins 控制器上的命令参数和选项。
由于Jenkins受影响版本中默认启用其CLI命令解析器的一个功能，特定的解析器功能expandAtFiles可将@参数中后跟文件路径的字符替换为文件内容，可能导致威胁者读取 Jenkins 控制器文件系统上的任意文件，或可以进一步利用该漏洞在多种情况下导致远程代码执行。
具有Overall/Read权限的攻击者可以读取整个文件。没有Overall/Read权限的攻击者可以读取文件的前几行。可以读取的行数取决于可用的CLI命令。
vuln_update.description_en:
Jenkins has a built-in command-line interface (CLI) that can be accessed from scripts or a shell environment. When processing CLI commands, Jenkins uses the args4j library to parse command arguments and options on the Jenkins controller.
Due to a feature of the CLI command parser that is enabled by default in the affected versions of Jenkins, a specific parser feature, expandAtFiles, which replaces the character following the @ parameter with a file path, can be exploited by an attacker to read arbitrary files on the Jenkins controller's file system, or further exploit the vulnerability to cause remote code execution in various scenarios.
An attacker with Overall/Read permissions can read the entire file. An attacker without Overall/Read permissions can read the first few lines of the file. The number of lines that can be read depends on the available CLI commands.

vuln_update.vuln_name: FreePBX 远程代码执行漏洞(CVE-2025-57819)
vuln_update.technical_category: SQL注入,备用路径身份认证绕过
vuln_update.description: FreePBX是一个基于Web的开源图形用户界面，广泛用于管理通信系统。受影响的FreePBX 15、16和17版本由于对用户提供的数据校验不足，允许未经身份验证的用户访问管理员界面，进而可以进行数据库操作和远程代码执行。
vuln_update.description_en: FreePBX is a web-based open-source graphical user interface widely used for managing communication systems. Affected FreePBX 15, 16, and 17 versions, due to insufficient validation of user-provided data, allow unauthenticated users to access the admin interface, thereby enabling database operations and remote code execution.

vuln_update.vuln_name: Citrix NetScaler 内存信息泄露漏洞(CVE-2025-5777)
vuln_update.vuln_name_en: Citrix NetScaler memory information disclosure vulnerability (CVE-2025-5777)
vuln_update.description: Citrix NetScaler是一种应用交付网络（ADN）设备，广泛用于负载均衡、流量管理、VPN服务和应用防火墙。该漏洞发生在NetScaler配置为网关（VPN虚拟服务、ICA代理、CVPN、RDP代理）或AAA虚拟服务时，由于输入验证不足，导致内存信息泄露过度。
vuln_update.description_en: Citrix NetScaler is an application delivery networking (ADN) device, widely used for load balancing, traffic management, VPN services, and application firewalls. vuln_update.vuln_name: Linux ibmvnic 驱动缓冲区溢出漏洞 (CVE-2025-22104)
vuln_update.vuln_name_en: Linux ibmvnic Driver Buffer Overflow Vulnerability (CVE-2025-22104)
vuln_update.threat_category: 代码执行,拒绝服务,信息泄露
vuln_update.description:
在Linux内核中，以下漏洞已得到解决：

ibmvnic：使用内核助手进行十六进制转储

以前，当驱动程序打印十六进制转储时，缓冲区被强制转换
到8字节长并使用字符串格式化程序打印。如果缓冲区
大小不是8的倍数，那么读取缓冲区溢出是可能的。

因此，创建一个新的ibmvnic函数，该函数循环缓冲区和
改为调用hex_dump_to_buffer。

此补丁地址Kasan报告如下：
ibmvnic 30000003 env3：登录缓冲区：
ibmvnic 30000003 env3:01000000af000000
<...>
ibmvnic 30000003 env3：2e6d62692e736261
ibmvnic 30000003 env3：65050003006d6f63
==================================================================
错误：kasan：ibmvnic_login+0xacc/0xffc[ibmwnic]中的slab-out-of-bounds
通过任务ip/17681在addr c0000001331a9aa8读取大小为8
<...>
任务17681分配：
<...>
ibmvnic_login+0x2f0/0xffc[ibmwnic]
ibmvnic_open+0x148/0x308[ibmwnic]
__dev_open+0x1ac/0x304
<...>
错误地址位于168字节内
分配的175字节区域[c0000001331a9a00, c00000131a9aaf)
<...>
=================================================================
ibmvnic 30000003 env3：000000000033766e
vuln_update.description_en:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ibmvnic: Use kernel helpers for hex dumps

Previously, when the driver was printing hex dumps, the buffer was cast
to an 8 byte long and printed using string formatters. If the buffer
size was not a multiple of 8 then a read buffer overflow was possible.

Therefore, create a new ibmvnic function that loops over a buffer and
calls hex_dump_to_buffer instead.

This patch address KASAN reports like the one below:
  ibmvnic 30000003 env3: Login Buffer:
  ibmvnic 30000003 env3: 01000000af000000
  <...>
  ibmvnic 30000003 env3: 2e6d62692e736261
  ibmvnic 30000003 env3: 65050003006d6f63
  ==================================================================
  BUG: KASAN: slab-out-of-bounds in ibmvnic_login+0xacc/0xffc [ibmvnic]
  Read of size 8 at addr c0000001331a9aa8 by task ip/17681
  <...>
  Allocated by task 17681:
  <...>
  ibmvnic_login+0x2f0/0xffc [ibmvnic]
  ibmvnic_open+0x148/0x308 [ibmvnic]
  __dev_open+0x1ac/0x304
  <...>
  The buggy address is located 168 bytes inside of
                allocated 175-byte region [c0000001331a9a00, c0000001331a9aaf)
  <...>
  =================================================================
  ibmvnic 30000003 env3: 000000000033766e

vuln_update.vuln_name: gradio-app gradio权限提升漏洞(CVE-2024-4254)
vuln_update.description: gradio-app/gradio存储库中的'deploy-website.yml'工作流，特别是在'main'分支中，由于授权不当而容易受到机密泄露的影响。该漏洞源于工作流从fork显式检出和执行代码，这是不安全的，因为它允许在有权推送到基础存储库和访问机密的环境中运行不受信任的代码。此缺陷可能会导致敏感机密泄露，例如GitHub_TOKEN、HF_TOOKEN、VERCEL_ORG_ID、VERCEL_PROJECT_ID、COMMENT_TOKEY、AWSACESSKKEYID、AWSSECRETKEY和VERCAL_TOKen。该漏洞存在于位于https://github.com/gradio-app/gradio/blob/72f4ca88ab569aae47941b3fb0609e57f2e13a27/.github/workflows/deploy-website.yml的工作流文件中。
vuln_update.description_en: The 'deploy-website.yml' workflow in the gradio-app/gradio repository, specifically in the 'main' branch, is vulnerable to secrets exfiltration due to improper authorization. The vulnerability arises from the workflow's explicit checkout and execution of code from a fork, which is unsafe as it allows the running of untrusted code in an environment with access to push to the base repository and access secrets. This flaw could lead to the exfiltration of sensitive secrets such as GITHUB_TOKEN, HF_TOKEN, VERCEL_ORG_ID, VERCEL_PROJECT_ID, COMMENT_TOKEN, AWSACCESSKEYID, AWSSECRETKEY, and VERCEL_TOKEN. The vulnerability is present in the workflow file located at https://github.com/gradio-app/gradio/blob/72f4ca88ab569aae47941b3fb0609e57f2e13a27/.github/workflows/deploy-website.yml.

vuln_update.vuln_name: Github Projen 安全漏洞(CVE-2021-21423)
vuln_update.technical_category: 将CVS仓库暴露给非授权控制范围
vuln_update.description: “projen”是一个项目生成工具，它从一个用JavaScript编写的类型良好的定义中合成项目配置文件，如'package.json'、'tsconfig.json'、'.gitignore'、GitHub工作流、'eslint'、“jest”等。 PROjEN的“NodeProject”项目类型（包括从其派生的任何项目类型）的用户包括“.github/工作流/rebuild-bot.yml”工作流，该工作流可以允许任何GitHub用户在“主”存储库的上下文中触发不受信任的代码的执行（与fork的相反）。 在某些情况下，这种不受信任的代码可能能够提交到“主”存储库。 rebuild-bot工作流由注释触发，注释在pull请求上包括“@PROjEN rebuild”，以触发PROjen项目的重建，并用更新的文件更新pull要求。 此工作流由"问题_注释"事件触发，因此总是使用属于向其中进行拉请求的存储库的"GitHub_TOKEN"来执行（这与由"拉请求"事件所触发的工作流形成对比，后者总是使用与从中进行拉请求库的"gitHub_TOKEN'来执行）。 没有在其默认分支上配置分支保护的存储库（通常是“主”或“主”）可能允许不受信任的用户访问存储库上配置的秘密（如NPM令牌等）。 分支保护禁止此升级，因为受管理的“GitHub_TOKEN”将无法修改受保护分支的内容，并且必须在默认分支上定义受影响的工作流。
vuln_update.description_en: "Projen" is a project generation tool that synthesizes project configuration files from a well-defined type written in JavaScript, such as' package.json ',' tsconfig.json ',. Gitignore', GitHub workflow, 'eslint', "jest" etc. PROjEN's "NodeProject" project type (including any type of project derived from it) includes... "github / workstream / rebuild-bot.yml" working stream, which allows any Github user to go up and down the main repository Triggers the execution of untrusted code in the text (contrary to fork). In some cases, this untrusted code may be able to be submitted to the "master" repository. The rebuild-bot workflow is triggered by an annotation that includes "@PROjENREbuild" on the pull request to trigger the reconstruction of the PROjen project and to update pull requirements with an updated file. This workflow is triggered by a "problem _ annotation" event and is therefore always executed using "GitHub _ TOKEN" that is part of the repository to which the pull request is directed (this is in contrast to the work flow generated by the pulled request event, which always uses "gitHubTOKEN' that pulls out of it). The repositories that do not have a branch protection configuration on their default branch (usually the" main "or" principal ") may allow untrusted users to access the secrets configured on the storage bank (e.g. NPM tokens, etc. Branch protection prohibits this escalation because the managed "GitHub _ TOKEN" will not modify the content of the protected branch and must define the affected workflow on the default branch.

Simple Machines Forum 2.1版本中的Packages.php文件存在代码注入漏洞。远程攻击者可借助‘themechanges array’参数利用该漏洞实施PHP对象注入攻击，执行任意的PHP代码。

vuln_update.vuln_name: espressif arduino-esp32代码执行漏洞(CVE-2024-45798)
vuln_update.threat_category: 信息泄露,拒绝服务,命令执行,代码执行
vuln_update.technical_category: 代码注入,数据验证不恰当,OS命令注入

vuln_update.description_en: arduino-esp32 is an Arduino core for the ESP32, ESP32-S2, ESP32-S3, ESP32-C3, ESP32-C6 and ESP32-H2 microcontrollers. The `arduino-esp32` CI is vulnerable to multiple Poisoned Pipeline Execution (PPE) vulnerabilities. Code injection in `tests_results.yml` workflow (`GHSL-2024-169`) and environment Variable injection (`GHSL-2024-170`). These issue have been addressed but users are advised to verify the contents of the downloaded artifacts.

vuln_update.vuln_name: Monkeytypegame Monkeytype信息泄露漏洞(CVE-2024-41127)
vuln_update.threat_category: 信息泄露,代码执行,拒绝服务
vuln_update.description: Monkeytype 是一个简约且可定制的打字测试工具。Monkeytype 容易受到通过其 GitHub 工作流 ci-failure-comment.yml 中的代码注入导致的中毒管道执行攻击，使攻击者能够获得拉取请求的写入权限。ci-failure-comment.yml 工作流在 Monkey CI 工作流完成后触发。当它运行时，会下载触发工作流上传的工件，并将 ./pr_num/pr_num.txt 工件的内容分配给 steps.pr_num_reader.outputs.content WorkFlow 变量。没有验证该变量实际上是一个数字，并且稍后它被插值到一个 JS 脚本中，允许攻击者更改要执行的代码。这个问题导致了拉取请求的写入权限。这个漏洞在 24.30.0 中被修复。
vuln_update.description_en: Monkeytype is a minimalistic and customizable typing test. Monkeytype is vulnerable to Poisoned Pipeline Execution through Code Injection in its ci-failure-comment.yml GitHub Workflow, enabling attackers to gain pull-requests write access. The ci-failure-comment.yml workflow is triggered when the Monkey CI workflow completes. When it runs, it will download an artifact uploaded by the triggering workflow and assign the contents of ./pr_num/pr_num.txt artifact to the steps.pr_num_reader.outputs.content WorkFlow variable. It is not validated that the variable is actually a number and later it is interpolated into a JS script allowing an attacker to change the code to be executed. This issue leads to pull-requests write access. This vulnerability is fixed in 24.30.0.
vuln_update.vuln_type: 信息泄露,代码执行,拒绝服务

key_vuln_add.vuln_name: Proxmox VE 未认证单请求 Root 认证绕过漏洞(QVD-2026-61075)
key_vuln_add.vuln_name_en: Proxmox VE Unauthenticated Single-Request Root Authentication Bypass Vulnerability (QVD-2026-61075)
key_vuln_add.threat_category: 代码执行,身份认证绕过
key_vuln_add.description:
pveproxy/pvedaemon 是 Proxmox VE 的 Web 与 API 服务组件，负责处理 Web 管理界面请求、RESTful API 调用、用户认证以及各种代理功能，默认监听 8006 端口。该组件在用户登录时通过 `/api2/json/access/ticket` 端点调用 libpve-access-control 完成密码验证与二次认证（TFA）验证并签发会话票据，是 Proxmox VE 安全架构的核心组成部分，广泛应用于私有云与虚拟化基础设施。
该漏洞源于 libpve-access-control（< 8.0.4）在登录票据签发流程中的认证逻辑缺陷。攻击者在请求登录票据端点时，在表单中构造非空的 `tfa-challenge` 参数并提交任意密码（如 `username=root@pam&password=any&tfa-challenge=any`），即可触发上述三段短路逻辑，绕过密码校验与二次认证校验，获得一张权限完整的 `root@pam` 票据。该票据可直接用于任意管理 API 调用，并可借由终端代理在宿主机上以 root 身份执行任意命令。
key_vuln_add.description_en:
pveproxy/pvedaemon is the Web and API service component of Proxmox VE, responsible for handling Web management interface requests, RESTful API calls, user authentication, and various proxy functions, and it listens on port 8006 by default. When a user logs in, this component calls the `/api2/json/access/ticket` endpoint to invoke libpve-access-control to complete password verification and two-factor authentication (TFA) verification and issue a session ticket, making it a core part of the Proxmox VE security architecture and widely used in private cloud and virtualization infrastructure.

This vulnerability stems from an authentication logic flaw in the login ticket issuance process in libpve-access-control (< 8.0.4). When an attacker requests the login ticket endpoint, by constructing a non-empty `tfa-challenge` parameter in the form and submitting any password (e.g., `username=root@pam&password=any&tfa-challenge=any`), the attacker can trigger the above three-stage short-circuit logic, bypass both password verification and two-factor authentication verification, and obtain a fully privileged `root@pam` ticket. This ticket can be used directly for arbitrary management API calls, and can be used via the terminal proxy to execute arbitrary commands as root on the host.
key_vuln_add.vuln_type: 代码执行,身份认证绕过

key_vuln_add.vuln_name: Windows HTTP.sys 整数溢出漏洞(CVE-2026-62735)
key_vuln_add.technical_category: 整数溢出,堆缓冲区溢出
key_vuln_add.description:
HTTP.sys是Windows操作系统内核模式下的HTTP协议栈驱动程序，主要用于处理HTTP请求和响应，为IIS（Internet Information Services）及其他应用程序提供高性能的Web服务支持。该组件负责HTTP请求的解析、连接管理、缓存处理以及协议相关的网络通信功能，是Windows平台Web服务架构的核心组成部分，广泛应用于Windows Server和客户端操作系统中。
该漏洞源于 HTTP.sys 驱动程序中的 UlpCreateInternalResponseOld 函数在处理 HTTP 响应头时，未对用户提供的头部字节总数进行充分的边界校验。在计算头部总字节数（TotalHeaderBytes）的过程中，多个变量相加时可能发生整数溢出，导致计算出的缓冲区大小远小于实际需要的大小。攻击者可利用该漏洞，通过构造特制的 HTTP 响应头部数据触发整数溢出，进而导致堆缓冲区溢出，最终在内核上下文中执行任意代码，实现本地权限提升至 SYSTEM 级别。
key_vuln_add.description_en:
HTTP.sys is the HTTP protocol stack driver in kernel mode of the Windows operating system, mainly used to handle HTTP requests and responses, providing high-performance Web service support for IIS (Internet Information Services) and other applications. This component is responsible for HTTP request parsing, connection management, cache processing, and protocol-related network communication functions, and is a core part of the Web service architecture on the Windows platform, widely used in Windows Server and client operating systems.

This vulnerability originates from the UlpCreateInternalResponseOld function in the HTTP.sys driver, which does not perform sufficient boundary validation on the total number of header bytes provided by the user when processing HTTP response headers. During the calculation of the total header byte count (TotalHeaderBytes), integer overflow may occur when multiple variables are added together, causing the calculated buffer size to be much smaller than the actual required size. Attackers can exploit this vulnerability by constructing specially crafted HTTP response header data to trigger integer overflow, which can then lead to heap buffer overflow and ultimately execute arbitrary code in kernel context, achieving local privilege escalation to SYSTEM level.

key_vuln_add.vuln_name: SonicWall SMA1000 服务器端请求伪造漏洞(CVE-2026-83548)
key_vuln_add.vuln_name_en: SonicWall SMA1000 Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability (CVE-2026-83548)
key_vuln_add.technical_category: 代理混淆,服务器端请求伪造
key_vuln_add.description: SonicWall SMA1000是一款面向企业级用户的远程安全访问解决方案，旨在为分布式员工和移动办公人员提供对内部应用程序及数据资源的安全接入能力。该设备支持基于Linux平台的部署，通过Work Place界面向授权用户提供基于Web的安全访问入口，使其能够通过标准浏览器便捷地连接到托管于本地数据中心或云端的企业资源。作为企业远程访问基础设施的关键组件，SMA1000广泛应用于各类组织的网络环境中，提供集中化的身份认证、访问控制及安全策略管理功能，保障远程访问过程的可靠性与安全性。受影响版本包括12.4.3-03453（platform-hotfix）及更早版本、12.5.0-02835（platform-hotfix）及更早版本。设备Work Place接口由于存在非预期的备用访问路径，导致在身份验证前即可处理恶意构造的请求。远程未认证攻击者可通过发送特制HTTP请求利用此缺陷，使服务器向攻击者指定的内部或外部资源发起请求，进而未经授权访问内部敏感功能、扫描内网服务或执行未授权操作，对系统机密性和完整性构成严重威胁。
key_vuln_add.description_en: SonicWall SMA1000 is a remote secure access solution for enterprise users, designed to provide distributed employees and mobile workers with secure access to internal applications and data resources. The device supports deployment on a Linux platform and provides a web-based secure access portal to authorized users through the Work Place interface, enabling them to conveniently connect to enterprise resources hosted in local data centers or the cloud via standard browsers. As a key component of enterprise remote access infrastructure, SMA1000 is widely used in the network environments of various organizations, providing centralized authentication, access control, and security policy management functions to ensure the reliability and security of remote access processes. Affected versions include 12.4.3-03453 (platform-hotfix) and earlier versions, and 12.5.0-02835 (platform-hotfix) and earlier versions. The Work Place interface of the device has an unexpected alternate access path, which allows it to process maliciously crafted requests before authentication. A remote unauthenticated attacker can exploit this vulnerability by sending a specially crafted HTTP request, causing the server to make requests to internal or external resources specified by the attacker, thereby accessing internal sensitive functions, scanning internal services, or performing unauthorized operations without authentication, posing a serious threat to the confidentiality and integrity of the system.

key_vuln_add.vuln_name: JFrog Artifactory 身份验证绕过漏洞(CVE-2026-82329)
key_vuln_add.description: JFrog Artifactory 是一款企业级通用制品库管理器，用于集中存储、管理和分发软件包、构建产物及相关依赖项，支持 Maven、Docker、npm 等多种包格式，广泛应用于 DevOps 流水线中，帮助组织实现制品的版本控制、安全扫描与二进制文件生命周期管理，提升软件交付效率与可追溯性。该漏洞影响多个特定维护版本分支，源于产品在默认配置下存在身份验证机制实现缺陷，远程攻击者无需提供任何有效凭证即可利用该缺陷突破认证边界，直接获取系统的最高管理权限，进而完全控制目标应用及其托管的敏感数据与制品资产。
key_vuln_add.description_en: JFrog Artifactory is an enterprise-grade universal repository manager used to centrally store, manage, and distribute software packages, build artifacts, and related dependencies. It supports multiple package formats such as Maven, Docker, and npm, and is widely used in DevOps pipelines to help organizations implement version control, security scanning, and binary file lifecycle management for software delivery efficiency and traceability. This vulnerability affects multiple specific maintenance version branches and stems from an authentication mechanism implementation defect in the product under default configuration. Remote attackers can exploit this defect without providing any valid credentials to bypass authentication and directly obtain the highest administrative privileges of the system, thereby fully controlling the target application and its hosted sensitive data and repository assets.

key_vuln_add.vuln_name: Sangoma Switchvox SMB Edition SQL注入漏洞(CVE-2026-9586)
key_vuln_add.vuln_name_en: Sangoma Switchvox SMB Edition SQL Injection Vulnerability (CVE-2026-9586)
key_vuln_add.description: Sangoma Switchvox SMB Edition是一款面向中小企业的统一通信（UC）和IP-PBX解决方案，提供语音通话、语音信箱、自动话务员、会议通话及呼叫中心等企业级通信功能，广泛应用于商业环境中的电话系统管理和通信协作。该系统支持基于SIP的IP语音传输，并集成了可视化管理界面，帮助企业简化通信流程、降低运营成本，适用于各类中小型组织的日常办公与客户服务场景。受影响版本在处理PolycomIPPhone相关XML请求时，/pa端点未对用户提交的PhoneIP参数进行过滤或参数化处理，直接将其拼接到后端PostgreSQL查询语句中。未经身份验证的远程攻击者可通过发送单个精心构造的XML请求注入任意SQL语句，进而操纵后台数据库，窃取敏感信息，甚至利用数据库扩展功能在服务器上执行远程代码。
key_vuln_add.description_en: Sangoma Switchvox SMB Edition is a unified communications (UC) and IP-PBX solution designed for small and medium-sized businesses, offering enterprise-grade communication features such as voice calling, voicemail, auto attendants, conference calling, and call center functionality, widely used in business environments for telephony system management and communication collaboration. The system supports SIP-based IP voice transmission and integrates a visual management interface to help enterprises simplify communication workflows and reduce operating costs, making it suitable for daily office operations and customer service scenarios in various small and medium-sized organizations. In affected versions, when processing PolycomIPPhone-related XML requests, the /pa endpoint does not filter or parameterize the user-submitted PhoneIP parameter, instead directly concatenating it into backend PostgreSQL query statements. An unauthenticated remote attacker can inject arbitrary SQL statements by sending a single carefully crafted XML request, thereby manipulating the backend database, stealing sensitive information, and potentially executing remote code on the server using database extension functionality.

key_vuln_add.vuln_name: SonicWall SMA1000-操作系统命令注入漏洞(CVE-2026-83549)
key_vuln_add.vuln_name_en: SonicWall SMA1000-Operating System Command Injection Vulnerability (CVE-2026-83549)
key_vuln_add.description: SonicWall SMA1000 是一款面向企业级用户的高端远程访问安全网关硬件平台，主要部署于数据中心或企业网络边界，为分布式办公场景下的远程用户提供安全的 SSL VPN 接入服务。该设备内置 Appliance Management Console (AMC) 管理控制台，支持管理员对设备进行统一配置、策略下发、系统监控及日志审计，从而大幅降低大规模安全网关的运维管理复杂度。SMA1000 具备高可用集群、多因子认证集成以及细粒度访问控制能力，广泛应用于金融、医疗、政府等对安全合规性要求严格的行业，是保障企业远程接入安全的关键基础设施。其灵活的部署模式与强大的性能扩展能力，使其能够满足从小型分支机构到大型跨国组织的多样化业务需求。该漏洞影响运行 12.4.3-03453 及更早版本、或 12.5.0-02835 及更早版本固件的设备。问题根源在于 AMC 管理控制台在处理用户输入时未能正确过滤特殊元素，导致操作系统命令注入风险。已获管理员权限的远程攻击者在特定条件下，可通过向管理接口提交恶意请求，在底层操作系统中注入并执行任意命令。成功利用将导致攻击者完全控制受影响设备，进而窃取敏感数据、植入持久化后门或破坏系统可用性。
key_vuln_add.description_en: SonicWall SMA1000 is a high-end remote access security gateway hardware platform for enterprise users, mainly deployed in data centers or at the enterprise network edge to provide secure SSL VPN access services for remote users in distributed office scenarios. The device has a built-in Appliance Management Console (AMC) management console, which supports administrators to perform unified configuration, policy distribution, system monitoring, and log auditing on the device, thereby greatly reducing the complexity of operations and maintenance management for large-scale security gateways. SMA1000 has high availability clustering, multi-factor authentication integration, and fine-grained access control capabilities, and is widely used in industries with strict security compliance requirements such as finance, healthcare, and government, and is a key infrastructure for ensuring secure remote access for enterprises. Its flexible deployment model and powerful performance scalability enable it to meet the diverse business needs of small branch offices to large multinational organizations. This vulnerability affects devices running firmware 12.4.3-03453 and earlier or 12.5.0-02835 and earlier. The root cause is that the AMC management console failed to correctly filter special elements when processing user input, resulting in an operating system command injection risk. A remote attacker with administrator privileges can inject and execute arbitrary commands in the underlying operating system by submitting malicious requests to the management interface under specific conditions. Successful exploitation will result in the attacker fully controlling the affected device, and then stealing sensitive data, implanting persistent backdoors, or destroying system availability.

key_vuln_add.technical_category: 身份认证错误,关键功能的认证机制缺失
key_vuln_add.description: LiteLLM 是一个代理服务器（AI 网关），用于以 OpenAI（或原生）格式调用 LLM API。在 1.84.0 之前，LiteLLM 的 MCP Streamable HTTP 端点允许未经身份验证的攻击者通过伪造的 Authorization 头部触发 OAuth2 透传回退路径，该路径将失败的 LiteLLM 密钥验证替换为空 UserAPIKeyAuth() 对象，从而使请求能够在没有有效 LiteLLM 密钥的情况下访问 MCP 工具。此问题已在版本 1.84.0 中修复。
key_vuln_add.description_en: LiteLLM is a proxy server (AI Gateway) to call LLM APIs in OpenAI (or native) format. Prior to 1.84.0, LiteLLM's MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint allowed an unauthenticated attacker to use a fabricated Authorization header to trigger an OAuth2 passthrough fallback path that replaced failed LiteLLM key validation with an empty UserAPIKeyAuth() object, allowing requests to reach MCP tooling without a valid LiteLLM key. This issue is fixed in version 1.84.0.

key_vuln_add.vuln_name: Kestra OSS 认证绕过远程代码执行漏洞 (CVE-2026-49869)
key_vuln_add.vuln_name_en: Kestra OSS Authentication Bypass Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (CVE-2026-49869)
key_vuln_add.threat_category: 命令执行,信息泄露,安全特性绕过,身份认证绕过
key_vuln_add.technical_category: 身份认证错误,OS命令注入,服务器端请求伪造,黑名单绕过
key_vuln_add.description: Kestra 是一款开源的、基于事件驱动的编排平台。在 1.0.45 和 1.3.21 之前的 Kestra OSS 版本中，AuthenticationFilter 使用 request.getPath().endsWith("/configs") 将公共配置端点列入基本身份验证的白名单。由于该检查是后缀匹配而非精确路径匹配，任何以 configs 结尾的 API 路径都会完全绕过身份验证。未经身份验证的远程攻击者可利用此漏洞在无需凭证的情况下创建和执行任意工作流。由于 Kestra 默认启用了脚本执行插件（如 plugin-script-shell、plugin-script-python 等），这将直接导致在 Kestra 工作容器内以 root 权限进行未经身份验证的远程代码执行。此漏洞已在 1.0.45 和 1.3.21 版本中修复。
key_vuln_add.description_en: Kestra is an open-source, event-driven orchestration platform. Prior to 1.0.45 and 1.3.21, AuthenticationFilter in Kestra OSS uses request.getPath().endsWith("/configs") to whitelist the public configuration endpoint from Basic Auth. Because the check is a suffix match rather than an exact path match, any API path whose last segment is configs bypasses authentication entirely. An unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit this to create and execute arbitrary workflows without credentials. Because Kestra ships with script execution plugins (plugin-script-shell, plugin-script-python, etc.) enabled by default, this directly results in unauthenticated Remote Code Execution as root inside the Kestra worker container.  This vulnerability is fixed in 1.0.45 and 1.3.21.

poc_exp_add.vuln_name: Proxmox VE 未认证单请求 Root 认证绕过漏洞(QVD-2026-61075)
poc_exp_add.vuln_name_en: Proxmox VE Unauthenticated Single-Request Root Authentication Bypass Vulnerability (QVD-2026-61075)
poc_exp_add.threat_category: 代码执行,身份认证绕过
poc_exp_add.description:
pveproxy/pvedaemon 是 Proxmox VE 的 Web 与 API 服务组件，负责处理 Web 管理界面请求、RESTful API 调用、用户认证以及各种代理功能，默认监听 8006 端口。该组件在用户登录时通过 `/api2/json/access/ticket` 端点调用 libpve-access-control 完成密码验证与二次认证（TFA）验证并签发会话票据，是 Proxmox VE 安全架构的核心组成部分，广泛应用于私有云与虚拟化基础设施。
该漏洞源于 libpve-access-control（< 8.0.4）在登录票据签发流程中的认证逻辑缺陷。攻击者在请求登录票据端点时，在表单中构造非空的 `tfa-challenge` 参数并提交任意密码（如 `username=root@pam&password=any&tfa-challenge=any`），即可触发上述三段短路逻辑，绕过密码校验与二次认证校验，获得一张权限完整的 `root@pam` 票据。该票据可直接用于任意管理 API 调用，并可借由终端代理在宿主机上以 root 身份执行任意命令。
poc_exp_add.description_en:
pveproxy/pvedaemon is the Web and API service component of Proxmox VE, responsible for handling Web management interface requests, RESTful API calls, user authentication, and various proxy functions, and it listens on port 8006 by default. When a user logs in, this component calls the `/api2/json/access/ticket` endpoint to invoke libpve-access-control to complete password verification and two-factor authentication (TFA) verification and issue a session ticket, making it a core part of the Proxmox VE security architecture and widely used in private cloud and virtualization infrastructure.

This vulnerability stems from an authentication logic flaw in the login ticket issuance process in libpve-access-control (< 8.0.4). When an attacker requests the login ticket endpoint, by constructing a non-empty `tfa-challenge` parameter in the form and submitting any password (e.g., `username=root@pam&password=any&tfa-challenge=any`), the attacker can trigger the above three-stage short-circuit logic, bypass both password verification and two-factor authentication verification, and obtain a fully privileged `root@pam` ticket. This ticket can be used directly for arbitrary management API calls, and can be used via the terminal proxy to execute arbitrary commands as root on the host.

poc_exp_add.vuln_name: Zimbra Collaboration 操作系统命令注入漏洞(CVE-2026-73570)
poc_exp_add.vuln_name_en: Zimbra Collaboration OS command injection vulnerability (CVE-2026-73570)
poc_exp_add.description: Zimbra Collaboration（ZCS）是一款功能全面的开源企业协作平台，提供电子邮件、日历、联系人管理、任务跟踪和文档共享等核心通信服务。该平台支持通过Web浏览器和各类移动设备访问，为企业提供安全可靠的内部通信和团队协作环境。其模块化架构允许管理员根据需求安装可选组件，包括用于系统监控和告警的SNMP服务模块，广泛应用于企业、政府机构和教育组织的IT基础设施中。在10.1.20之前的受影响版本中，当系统安装了可选的zimbra-snmp软件包并启用SNMP通知功能时，由于在通知处理过程中对不受信任的输入数据过滤不当，未经身份验证的远程攻击者可通过发送特制的SMTP请求注入恶意命令，最终导致以Zimbra用户身份执行任意操作系统命令，造成服务器完全失控。
poc_exp_add.description_en: Zimbra Collaboration (ZCS) is a comprehensive open-source enterprise collaboration platform that provides core communication services such as email, calendar, contact management, task tracking, and document sharing. The platform supports access via web browsers and various mobile devices, providing enterprises with a secure and reliable internal communication and team collaboration environment. Its modular architecture allows administrators to install optional components according to needs, including the SNMP service module for system monitoring and alerts, which is widely used in the IT infrastructure of enterprises, government agencies, and educational organizations. In affected versions prior to 10.1.20, when the optional zimbra-snmp package is installed and SNMP notification functionality is enabled, due to improper filtering of untrusted input data during the notification processing, unauthenticated remote attackers can inject malicious commands by sending specially crafted SMTP requests, ultimately leading to arbitrary operating system commands being executed as the Zimbra user, resulting in complete loss of control of the server.

poc_exp_add.vuln_name: Sangoma Switchvox SMB Edition SQL注入漏洞(CVE-2026-9586)
poc_exp_add.vuln_name_en: Sangoma Switchvox SMB Edition SQL Injection Vulnerability (CVE-2026-9586)
poc_exp_add.description: Sangoma Switchvox SMB Edition是一款面向中小企业的统一通信（UC）和IP-PBX解决方案，提供语音通话、语音信箱、自动话务员、会议通话及呼叫中心等企业级通信功能，广泛应用于商业环境中的电话系统管理和通信协作。该系统支持基于SIP的IP语音传输，并集成了可视化管理界面，帮助企业简化通信流程、降低运营成本，适用于各类中小型组织的日常办公与客户服务场景。受影响版本在处理PolycomIPPhone相关XML请求时，/pa端点未对用户提交的PhoneIP参数进行过滤或参数化处理，直接将其拼接到后端PostgreSQL查询语句中。未经身份验证的远程攻击者可通过发送单个精心构造的XML请求注入任意SQL语句，进而操纵后台数据库，窃取敏感信息，甚至利用数据库扩展功能在服务器上执行远程代码。
poc_exp_add.description_en: Sangoma Switchvox SMB Edition is a unified communications (UC) and IP-PBX solution designed for small and medium-sized businesses, offering enterprise-grade communication features such as voice calling, voicemail, auto attendants, conference calling, and call center functionality, widely used in business environments for telephony system management and communication collaboration. The system supports SIP-based IP voice transmission and integrates a visual management interface to help enterprises simplify communication workflows and reduce operating costs, making it suitable for daily office operations and customer service scenarios in various small and medium-sized organizations. In affected versions, when processing PolycomIPPhone-related XML requests, the /pa endpoint does not filter or parameterize the user-submitted PhoneIP parameter, instead directly concatenating it into backend PostgreSQL query statements. An unauthenticated remote attacker can inject arbitrary SQL statements by sending a single carefully crafted XML request, thereby manipulating the backend database, stealing sensitive information, and potentially executing remote code on the server using database extension functionality.

poc_exp_add.vuln_name: SimpleHelp OIDC身份验证绕过漏洞(CVE-2026-48558)
poc_exp_add.vuln_name_en: SimpleHelp OIDC Authentication Bypass Vulnerability (CVE-2026-48558)
poc_exp_add.description: SimpleHelp是一款远程监控与管理（RMM）解决方案，专为IT服务提供商和企业技术支持团队设计，提供安全的远程访问、桌面控制和系统管理功能。该软件允许技术人员通过互联网远程连接终端设备，执行故障排除、软件安装、系统维护和技术支持任务。其架构支持多平台部署，包括Windows、macOS和Linux系统，并提供基于Web的管理界面和移动应用程序支持。SimpleHelp广泛应用于托管服务提供商（MSP）和内部IT部门，用于管理分布式IT基础设施和提供实时远程协助服务。受影响版本在配置OIDC身份验证时，未对提交的身份令牌进行加密签名验证。攻击者可构造包含任意身份声明的伪造令牌提交至系统，无需有效凭据即可获取完全认证的技术人员会话。此漏洞可能导致未授权访问受管设备、敏感数据泄露，并在特定配置下绕过多因素身份验证机制。
poc_exp_add.description_en: SimpleHelp is a remote monitoring and management (RMM) solution designed for IT service providers and enterprise technical support teams, providing secure remote access, desktop control, and system management functions. The software allows technicians to remotely connect to endpoint devices over the internet to perform troubleshooting, software installation, system maintenance, and technical support tasks. Its architecture supports multi-platform deployment, including Windows, macOS, and Linux systems, and provides a web-based management interface along with mobile application support. SimpleHelp is widely used by managed service providers (MSPs) and internal IT departments to manage distributed IT infrastructure and provide real-time remote assistance services. In affected versions, when configuring OIDC authentication, the submitted identity tokens are not validated with an encrypted signature. An attacker can submit a forged token containing arbitrary identity claims to the system and obtain a fully authenticated technician session without valid credentials. This vulnerability may lead to unauthorized access to managed devices, sensitive data leakage, and, under certain configurations, bypass of multi-factor authentication mechanisms.

poc_exp_add.vuln_name: Linux Kernel rtmutex 本地权限提升漏洞(CVE-2026-43499)
poc_exp_add.vuln_name_en: Linux Kernel rtmutex Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability (CVE-2026-43499)
poc_exp_add.description:
Linux 内核是开源操作系统 Linux 的核心组件，负责管理系统资源、硬件抽象、进程调度、内存管理、文件系统、网络协议栈以及设备驱动等关键功能。它作为用户空间与硬件之间的桥梁，为全球数以亿计的服务器、嵌入式设备、云计算平台、超级计算机及移动设备提供底层运行支撑。Linux 内核采用模块化设计，支持多种 CPU 架构，具有高度可配置性和稳定性，是现代IT基础设施的核心基石。
该漏洞源于内核实时互斥锁（rtmutex）组件中的 remove_waiter() 函数在代理锁回滚路径中错误地操作 current 任务而非 waiter::task。当 rt_mutex_start_proxy_lock() 通过 futex_requeue() 被调用时，remove_waiter() 在回滚场景下将 current（即发起重排队的线程）当作待清理的等待者，导致等待者任务的 pi_blocked_on 指针未被清除，从而指向已释放的内核栈帧。攻击者可利用该漏洞，通过构造三个 futex 词和三个线程形成 PI 依赖循环，触发 -EDEADLK 回滚路径，使等待者任务持有指向其已弹出栈帧的悬空指针，进而实现受限的任意地址写操作，最终劫持函数表指针完成控制流劫持，获取 root 权限并实现容器逃逸。
poc_exp_add.description_en:
The Linux kernel is the core component of the open-source operating system Linux, responsible for managing system resources, hardware abstraction, process scheduling, memory management, file systems, network protocol stacks, and device drivers. It serves as a bridge between user space and hardware, providing underlying support for billions of servers, embedded devices, cloud computing platforms, supercomputers, and mobile devices worldwide. The Linux kernel adopts a modular design, supports multiple CPU architectures, and features high configurability and stability, forming the cornerstone of modern IT infrastructure.

This vulnerability stems from the incorrect operation of the `current` task instead of `waiter::task` in the proxy lock rollback path of the `remove_waiter()` function within the kernel's real-time mutex (rtmutex) component. When `rt_mutex_start_proxy_lock()` is invoked via `futex_requeue()`, `remove_waiter()` mistakenly treats `current` (the thread initiating the requeue) as the waiting entity to be cleaned up in rollback scenarios. This results in the `pi_blocked_on` pointer of the waiting task not being cleared, causing it to reference a released kernel stack frame. Attackers can exploit this vulnerability by constructing three futex words and three threads to form a PI dependency cycle, triggering the `-EDEADLK` rollback path. This leaves the waiting task with a dangling pointer to its own popped stack frame, enabling restricted arbitrary address writes. Ultimately, attackers can hijack function table pointers to achieve control flow hijacking, gain root privileges, and escape containers.

poc_exp_add.vuln_name: Composer-不可信仓库依赖执行命令-漏洞(CVE-2026-84361)
poc_exp_add.vuln_name_en: Composer-Untrusted Repository Dependency Command Execution-Vulnerability (CVE-2026-84361)
poc_exp_add.description: Composer 是 PHP 语言的依赖管理工具。从 1.0 到 2.2.30 以及 2.10.3，来自自定义 Composer 存储库的恶意依赖软件包，或来自不受信任的 composer.lock 文件，可能将 source.type 设置为 perforce，并将 source.url 设置为以 rsh: 或 jsh: 开头的 P4PORT 值。当安装了 Perforce p4 客户端，并且 Composer 通过 composer install 或 composer update（包括 --prefer-source）从源码安装该软件包时，Composer\Util\Perforce 会未经验证就将地址传递给 p4，导致 p4 以用户或 CI 账户的权限运行本地命令。Packagist.org 不允许使用 Perforce 源元数据。该问题已在 2.2.30 和 2.10.3 版本中修复。
poc_exp_add.description_en: Composer is a dependency Manager for the PHP language. From 1.0 until 2.2.30 and 2.10.3, a malicious dependency package from a custom Composer repository or an untrusted composer.lock file could set source.type to perforce and source.url to an rsh: or jsh: P4PORT value. When the Perforce p4 client was installed and Composer installed the package from source through composer install or composer update, including --prefer-source, Composer\Util\Perforce passed the address to p4 without validation, causing p4 to run a local command with the privileges of the user or CI account. Packagist.org does not permit Perforce source metadata. This issue is fixed in versions 2.2.30 and 2.10.3.

poc_exp_add.vuln_name: NetScaler ADC Gateway漏洞(CVE-2026-19490)
poc_exp_add.vuln_name_en: NetScaler ADC Gateway Vulnerability (CVE-2026-19490)
poc_exp_add.description: NetScaler ADC（应用交付控制器）和NetScaler Gateway是Citrix旗下的企业级网络应用交付和安全远程访问解决方案。ADC提供负载均衡、应用加速、SSL卸载和Web应用防火墙等功能，确保企业应用的高可用性和性能优化；Gateway则为远程用户提供安全的VPN接入和单点登录服务，支持从任何设备安全访问企业内网资源。受影响版本包括ADC和Gateway的14.1至73.32以及13.1至63.21版本。该漏洞源于软件处理特定网络请求时存在的安全缺陷，未经身份验证的远程攻击者可通过向受影响系统发送恶意构造的请求来触发漏洞。成功利用可能导致攻击者在目标系统上执行任意代码、获取系统完全控制权或导致敏感信息泄露，对企业网络安全构成严重威胁。
poc_exp_add.description_en: NetScaler ADC (Application Delivery Controller) and NetScaler Gateway are enterprise-grade network application delivery and secure remote access solutions under Citrix. ADC provides load balancing, application acceleration, SSL offloading, and web application firewall capabilities to ensure high availability and performance optimization of enterprise applications; Gateway provides secure VPN access and single sign-on services for remote users, supporting secure access to enterprise internal network resources from any device. Affected versions include ADC and Gateway 14.1 to 73.32 and 13.1 to 63.21. The vulnerability stems from a security flaw in the software's handling of specific network requests, and an unauthenticated remote attacker can trigger the vulnerability by sending maliciously crafted requests to the affected system. Successful exploitation may allow attackers to execute arbitrary code on the target system, gain full control of the system, or cause sensitive information disclosure, posing a serious threat to enterprise network security.

poc_exp_add.vuln_name: Microsoft UFO未授权设备控制漏洞(CVE-2026-73296)

poc_exp_add.vuln_name: DIYgod RSSHub代码执行漏洞(CVE-2024-47179)
poc_exp_add.vuln_name_en: DIYgod RSSHub Code Execution Vulnerability (CVE-2024-47179)
poc_exp_add.threat_category: 拒绝服务,代码执行,信息泄露
poc_exp_add.description: RSSHub 是一个 RSS 网络。在提交 64e00e7 之前，RSSHub 的 `docker-test-cont.yml` 工作流容易受到工件投毒的攻击，这可能导致对整个仓库的接管。RSSHub 的下游用户不受此问题的影响，提交 64e00e7 修复了根本问题，使仓库不再容易受到攻击。`docker-test-cont.yml` 工作流在 `PR - Docker build test` 工作流成功完成后被触发。然后它收集一些关于触发触发工作流的拉取请求的信息，并根据 PR 本体和发送者设置一些标签。如果 PR 还包含一个 `routes` markdown 块，它将设置 `TEST_CONTINUE` 环境变量为 `true`。然后工作流下载并提取触发工作流上传的工件，预期包含一个 `rsshub.tar.zst` 文件。然而，在提交 64e00e7 之前，它没有验证内容，而是在工作区的根目录中提取，覆盖任何现有文件。由于工件的内容没有验证，恶意行为者有可能发送一个拉取请求，上传的不仅仅是 `rsshub.tar.zst` 压缩的 Docker 镜像，还有一个包含在特权工作流上下文中运行任意代码的脚本的恶意 `package.json` 文件。从提交 64e00e7 开始，这种情况已经得到解决，RSSHub 仓库不再容易受到攻击。
poc_exp_add.description_en: RSSHub is an RSS network. Prior to commit 64e00e7, RSSHub's `docker-test-cont.yml` workflow is vulnerable to Artifact Poisoning, which could have lead to a full repository takeover. Downstream users of RSSHub are not vulnerable to this issue, and commit 64e00e7 fixed the underlying issue and made the repository no longer vulnerable. The `docker-test-cont.yml` workflow gets triggered when the `PR - Docker build test` workflow completes successfully. It then collects some information about the Pull Request that triggered the triggering workflow and set some labels depending on the PR body and sender. If the PR also contains a `routes` markdown block, it will set the `TEST_CONTINUE` environment variable to `true`. The workflow then downloads and extracts an artifact uploaded by the triggering workflow which is expected to contain a single `rsshub.tar.zst` file. However, prior to commit 64e00e7, it did not validate and the contents were extracted in the root of the workspace overriding any existing files. Since the contents of the artifact were not validated, it is possible for a malicious actor to send a Pull Request which uploads, not just the `rsshub.tar.zst` compressed docker image, but also a malicious `package.json` file with a script to run arbitrary code in the context of the privileged workflow. As of commit 64e00e7, this scenario has been addressed and the RSSHub repository is no longer vulnerable.

poc_exp_add.vuln_name: Amelia插件权限提升漏洞(CVE-2026-9055)
poc_exp_add.vuln_name_en: Amelia plugin privilege escalation vulnerability (CVE-2026-9055)
poc_exp_add.description: 面向预约和事件日历的 Booking for Appointments and Events Calendar – Amelia (Premium) WordPress 插件在 8.0 - 9.6.2 版本中存在权限提升漏洞。这是由于在客户更新端点中对攻击者可控的 'type' 参数验证不足，使得客户可以将自己的角色设置为 'manager'，并在 'externalId' 参数设置为 0 时触发创建一个具有 wpamelia-manager 角色的 WordPress 用户。这使得未经身份验证的攻击者有可能通过先将自身提升为 manager 角色，然后创建一个与管理用户 ID 关联提供商实体并覆盖该管理员密码，从而将自己的权限提升为管理员。
poc_exp_add.description_en: The Booking for Appointments and Events Calendar – Amelia (Premium) plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in versions 8.0 - 9.6.2. This is due to insufficient validation of the attacker-controlled 'type' parameter in the customer update endpoint, which allows customers to set their role to 'manager' and trigger creation of a WordPress user with the wpamelia-manager role when the 'externalId' parameter is set to 0. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to escalate their privileges to administrator by first elevating to the manager role, then creating a provider entity linked to an administrator user ID and overwriting that administrator's password.

poc_exp_add.description: gradio-app/gradio存储库中存在命令注入漏洞，特别是在'test-functional.yml'工作流中。该漏洞是由于在命令中使用的特殊元素转义处理不恰当导致的，允许未经授权修改基础存储库或秘密泄露。该问题会影响'@gradio/video@0.6.12'及以下版本。该缺陷存在于工作流对GitHub上下文信息的处理中，它在没有充分清理的情况下呼应了头部存储库、头部分支和工作流引用的全名。这可能会导致敏感机密的泄露，例如'GITHUB_TOKEN'、'COMMENT_OKEN'和'CHROMATIC_PROJECT_TOKEN'。

The vulnerability arises due to improper neutralization of special elements used in a command, allowing for unauthorized modification of the base repository or secrets exfiltration. The issue affects versions up to and including '@gradio/video@0.6.12'. poc_exp_add.vuln_name: JetBrains TeamCity 远程代码执行漏洞(CVE-2026-63077)
poc_exp_add.vuln_name_en: JetBrains TeamCity Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (CVE-2026-63077)
poc_exp_add.description: TeamCity是JetBrains开发的一款持续集成和持续交付(CI/CD)服务器，广泛用于企业软件开发自动化构建、测试和部署场景。TeamCity提供Web管理界面和REST API，并通过代理轮询协议（Agent Polling Protocol）与构建代理通信。该产品基于Java开发，支持多平台部署。该漏洞源于TeamCity在处理未经身份验证的代理轮询请求时，使用了权限过宽的XStream类类型白名单，允许攻击者通过构造恶意的XML反序列化载荷实现远程代码执行。攻击者仅需能够通过HTTP或HTTPS访问TeamCity服务器，无需任何凭据即可完全控制服务器。
poc_exp_add.description_en: TeamCity is a continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) server developed by JetBrains, widely used in enterprise software development for automated build, test, and deployment scenarios. TeamCity provides a web management interface and a REST API, and communicates with build agents through the Agent Polling Protocol. The product is developed based on Java and supports multi-platform deployment. This vulnerability arises from TeamCity using an overly permissive XStream class type whitelist when processing unauthenticated agent polling requests, allowing attackers to achieve remote code execution by crafting malicious XML deserialization payloads. Attackers only need to be able to access the TeamCity server via HTTP or HTTPS and can fully control the server without any credentials.

poc_exp_add.description:

poc_exp_add.description_en:

poc_exp_add.vuln_name: SmarterTools SmarterMail 远程代码执行漏洞(CVE-2026-24423)
poc_exp_add.vuln_name_en: SmarterTools SmarterMail remote code execution vulnerability (CVE-2026-24423)
poc_exp_add.technical_category: 关键功能的认证机制缺失
poc_exp_add.description:
SmarterMail 是一款由 SmarterTools 公司开发的企业级邮件服务器软件，适用于 Windows 平台。它提供完整的电子邮件、日历、联系人、任务管理和即时消息功能，支持标准协议如 SMTP、POP3、IMAP 以及 CalDAV 和 CardDAV，便于与各类邮件客户端（如 Outlook、Thunderbird、移动设备等）集成。
该漏洞源于 ConnectToHub API 接口未对访问者进行身份验证。攻击者可通过构造特定请求，诱导 SmarterMail 服务器指向恶意 HTTP 服务器，进而向 SmarterMail 返回恶意操作系统命令。攻击者可以远程执行任意命令，完全控制受影响的系统，导致数据泄露、服务中断等严重后果。
poc_exp_add.description_en:
SmarterMail is an enterprise email server software developed by SmarterTools, designed for the Windows platform. It provides comprehensive email, calendar, contacts, task management, and instant messaging functionalities, and supports standard protocols such as SMTP, POP3, IMAP, as well as CalDAV and CardDAV, enabling seamless integration with various email clients (e.g., Outlook, Thunderbird, mobile devices, etc.).

The vulnerability stems from the ConnectToHub API endpoint not performing authentication for visitors. An attacker can craft a specific request to trick the SmarterMail server into pointing to a malicious HTTP server, which then returns malicious operating system commands to SmarterMail. This allows the attacker to execute arbitrary commands remotely, gaining full control over the affected system and potentially leading to data breaches, service disruption, and other severe consequences.

poc_exp_add.vuln_name: GNU InetUtils telnetd 远程认证绕过漏洞(CVE-2026-24061)
poc_exp_add.vuln_name_en: GNU InetUtils telnetd remote authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-24061)
poc_exp_add.description: 该漏洞存在于 telnetd 服务端 1.9.3–2.7 版本中。telnetd 在调用系统 /usr/bin/login 程序时，未对从客户端 USER 环境变量传入的用户名做过滤，直接拼接到 login 命令行。远程攻击者可利用该缺陷，在无需任何口令的情况下直接获取目标主机的 root shell，造成完全控制权泄露、敏感信息被窃取或进一步横向移动。由于 telnet 协议本身明文传输，且该漏洞可在默认配置触发，危害程度极高。
poc_exp_add.description_en: This vulnerability exists in telnetd server versions 1.9.3–2.7. When calling the system /usr/bin/login program, telnetd does not filter the username passed from the client's USER environment variable, directly appending it to the login command line. Remote attackers can exploit this flaw to directly obtain a root shell on the target host without any password, leading to complete control compromise, sensitive information theft, or further lateral movement. Due to the telnet protocol transmitting data in plaintext and the vulnerability being triggerable under default configurations, the severity is extremely high.

poc_exp_add.vuln_name_en: Apache Tomcat RewriteValve path traversal vulnerability (CVE-2025-55752)
poc_exp_add.description: Apache Tomcat是一个开源的Web服务器和Servlet容器，广泛用于Web应用的部署和运行。该漏洞产生于修复bug 60013时引入的回归问题，导致重写的URL在解码前被规范化，可能允许攻击者操纵请求URI绕过安全限制，包括对/WEB-INF/和/META-INF/的保护。如果同时启用了PUT请求，攻击者可以上传恶意文件，导致远程代码执行。
poc_exp_add.description_en: Apache Tomcat is an open-source web server and Servlet container, widely used for deploying and running web applications. This vulnerability arises from a regression introduced while fixing bug 60013, causing rewritten URLs to be normalized before decoding, which may allow attackers to manipulate request URIs to bypass security restrictions, including protection for /WEB-INF/ and /META-INF/. If PUT requests are enabled simultaneously, attackers can upload malicious files, leading to remote code execution.

poc_exp_add.vuln_name: Google Chrome V8引擎内存破坏漏洞(CVE-2026-7899)
poc_exp_add.vuln_name_en: Google Chrome V8 Engine Memory Corruption Vulnerability (CVE-2026-7899)
poc_exp_add.description: Google Chrome是一款由Google开发的跨平台网页浏览器，广泛应用于Windows、macOS和Linux系统，提供快速稳定的网络访问能力和丰富的扩展功能。该浏览器采用多进程架构和沙箱安全机制，内置高性能V8 JavaScript引擎用于执行网页脚本，支持现代Web标准和复杂的网络应用程序。作为全球市场份额最高的浏览器，Chrome为数亿用户提供日常的网页浏览、在线办公和数字娱乐服务，并通过自动更新机制持续提供安全保护。在148.0.7778.96版本之前，Chrome的V8引擎存在内存边界检查缺陷，导致越界读写问题。攻击者可通过构造包含恶意JavaScript代码的HTML网页，诱导用户访问后利用该内存破坏漏洞在沙箱内执行任意代码，从而获取系统控制权或窃取敏感数据。
poc_exp_add.description_en: Google Chrome is a cross-platform web browser developed by Google. It is widely used in Windows, macOS and Linux systems. It provides fast and stable network access capabilities and rich extension functions. The browser uses a multi-process architecture and sandbox security mechanism, and a built-in high-performance V8 JavaScript engine is used to execute web scripts and support modern web standards and complex web applications. As the browser with the highest global market share, Chrome provides daily web browsing, online office and digital entertainment services to hundreds of millions of users, and continuously provides security protection through automatic update mechanisms. Chrome's V8 engine prior to version 148.0.7778.96 had a memory boundary check flaw leading to an out-of-bounds read and write issue. Attackers can use this memory corruption vulnerability to execute arbitrary code in the sandbox by constructing HTML web pages containing malicious JavaScript code to induce users to visit, thereby gaining system control or stealing sensitive data.

poc_exp_add.vuln_name: gradio-app gradio权限提升漏洞(CVE-2024-4254)
poc_exp_add.vuln_name_en: gradio-app gradio privilege escalation vulnerability (CVE-2024-4254)
poc_exp_add.description: gradio-app/gradio存储库中的'deploy-website.yml'工作流，特别是在'main'分支中，由于授权不当而容易受到机密泄露的影响。该漏洞源于工作流从fork显式检出和执行代码，这是不安全的，因为它允许在有权推送到基础存储库和访问机密的环境中运行不受信任的代码。此缺陷可能会导致敏感机密泄露，例如GitHub_TOKEN、HF_TOOKEN、VERCEL_ORG_ID、VERCEL_PROJECT_ID、COMMENT_TOKEY、AWSACESSKKEYID、AWSSECRETKEY和VERCAL_TOKen。该漏洞存在于位于https://github.com/gradio-app/gradio/blob/72f4ca88ab569aae47941b3fb0609e57f2e13a27/.github/workflows/deploy-website.yml的工作流文件中。
poc_exp_add.description_en: The 'deploy-website.yml' workflow in the gradio-app/gradio repository, specifically in the 'main' branch, is vulnerable to secrets exfiltration due to improper authorization. The vulnerability arises from the workflow's explicit checkout and execution of code from a fork, which is unsafe as it allows the running of untrusted code in an environment with access to push to the base repository and access secrets. This flaw could lead to the exfiltration of sensitive secrets such as GITHUB_TOKEN, HF_TOKEN, VERCEL_ORG_ID, VERCEL_PROJECT_ID, COMMENT_TOKEN, AWSACCESSKEYID, AWSSECRETKEY, and VERCEL_TOKEN. The vulnerability is present in the workflow file located at https://github.com/gradio-app/gradio/blob/72f4ca88ab569aae47941b3fb0609e57f2e13a27/.github/workflows/deploy-website.yml.
