patch_add.vuln_name: Proxmox VE 未认证单请求 Root 认证绕过漏洞(QVD-2026-61075)
patch_add.vuln_name_en: Proxmox VE Unauthenticated Single-Request Root Authentication Bypass Vulnerability (QVD-2026-61075)
patch_add.threat_category: 代码执行,身份认证绕过
patch_add.description:
pveproxy/pvedaemon 是 Proxmox VE 的 Web 与 API 服务组件，负责处理 Web 管理界面请求、RESTful API 调用、用户认证以及各种代理功能，默认监听 8006 端口。该组件在用户登录时通过 `/api2/json/access/ticket` 端点调用 libpve-access-control 完成密码验证与二次认证（TFA）验证并签发会话票据，是 Proxmox VE 安全架构的核心组成部分，广泛应用于私有云与虚拟化基础设施。
该漏洞源于 libpve-access-control（< 8.0.4）在登录票据签发流程中的认证逻辑缺陷。攻击者在请求登录票据端点时，在表单中构造非空的 `tfa-challenge` 参数并提交任意密码（如 `username=root@pam&password=any&tfa-challenge=any`），即可触发上述三段短路逻辑，绕过密码校验与二次认证校验，获得一张权限完整的 `root@pam` 票据。该票据可直接用于任意管理 API 调用，并可借由终端代理在宿主机上以 root 身份执行任意命令。
patch_add.description_en:
pveproxy/pvedaemon is the Web and API service component of Proxmox VE, responsible for handling Web management interface requests, RESTful API calls, user authentication, and various proxy functions, and it listens on port 8006 by default. When a user logs in, this component calls the `/api2/json/access/ticket` endpoint to invoke libpve-access-control to complete password verification and two-factor authentication (TFA) verification and issue a session ticket, making it a core part of the Proxmox VE security architecture and widely used in private cloud and virtualization infrastructure.

This vulnerability stems from an authentication logic flaw in the login ticket issuance process in libpve-access-control (< 8.0.4). When an attacker requests the login ticket endpoint, by constructing a non-empty `tfa-challenge` parameter in the form and submitting any password (e.g., `username=root@pam&password=any&tfa-challenge=any`), the attacker can trigger the above three-stage short-circuit logic, bypass both password verification and two-factor authentication verification, and obtain a fully privileged `root@pam` ticket. This ticket can be used directly for arbitrary management API calls, and can be used via the terminal proxy to execute arbitrary commands as root on the host.
patch_add.vuln_type: 代码执行,身份认证绕过

patch_add.vuln_name: PaperCut MF/NG 远程代码执行漏洞(CVE-2026-82078)
patch_add.vuln_name_en: PaperCut MF/NG Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (CVE-2026-82078)
patch_add.description: PaperCut MF和PaperCut NG是企业级打印管理解决方案，广泛应用于政府机构、教育组织和商业企业环境中。该平台用于集中管控组织内部的打印队列、实现安全打印释放功能、执行多因素用户身份验证以及生成符合合规要求的详细打印活动审计报告。系统支持跨平台部署，提供直观的Web管理界面，帮助信息技术部门优化打印资源使用、降低运营成本并增强文档输出安全性。平台支持与多种外部数据库系统深度集成，用于持久化存储系统配置信息、用户账户数据、权限策略和完整审计日志，是组织内部打印基础设施的核心管理组件。其客户端-服务器架构允许管理员对分布式打印环境进行统一策略下发和实时监控。受影响版本的数据库连接工具在加载驱动类时缺乏有效验证，未将可配置的类名限制在预批准列表内。攻击者若已获取足够权限，可通过修改系统配置指定恶意类路径，诱导服务器加载并执行任意Java字节码。此缺陷使得攻击者能够在服务器进程的安全上下文中实现远程代码执行，进而完全控制目标系统或发起进一步攻击。
patch_add.description_en: PaperCut MF and PaperCut NG are enterprise-grade print management solutions widely used in government agencies, educational organizations, and commercial enterprise environments. The platform is used to centrally manage print queues within an organization, enable secure print release, enforce multi-factor user authentication, and generate detailed print activity audit reports that meet compliance requirements. The system supports cross-platform deployment and provides an intuitive web-based management interface that helps IT departments optimize print resource usage, reduce operating costs, and enhance document output security. The platform supports deep integration with multiple external database systems for persistent storage of system configuration data, user account data, permission policies, and complete audit logs, making it a core management component of an organization's print infrastructure. Its client-server architecture allows administrators to uniformly deploy policies and perform real-time monitoring in distributed print environments. In affected versions, the database connection tool lacks effective validation when loading driver classes and does not restrict configurable class names to a pre-approved list. An attacker with sufficient privileges can modify system configuration to specify a malicious class path, causing the server to load and execute arbitrary Java bytecode. This flaw enables an attacker to achieve remote code execution in the security context of the server process and thereby fully control the target system or launch further attacks.

patch_add.vuln_name: PaperCut MF/NG 身份认证绕过漏洞(CVE-2026-81578)
patch_add.vuln_name_en: PaperCut MF/NG Authentication Bypass Vulnerability (CVE-2026-81578)
patch_add.description: PaperCut MF和PaperCut NG是面向企业与教育机构的主流打印管理软件，提供跨平台的打印任务监控、成本分摊、配额控制及设备状态管理功能。该软件通过集成现有目录服务实现用户身份统一管理，并借助基于Web的管理控制台让管理员能够远程配置打印策略、审核日志及维护系统参数。作为文档输出基础设施的核心组件，其广泛应用于政府、医疗及大型办公网络环境，支持混合云和本地部署模式。受影响版本涵盖24.1.10之前、25.0.13之前及26.0.5之前的特定发行版本。该漏洞源于Web管理接口在处理管理功能请求时，后端操作在身份验证与访问控制检查完成之前即被触发。未经身份验证的远程攻击者可通过发送恶意HTTP请求直接调用管理端点，从而绕过正常的认证流程并对系统配置进行未授权修改。成功利用可能导致系统完整性受损，并为后续横向移动或数据窃取创造条件。
patch_add.description_en: PaperCut MF and PaperCut NG are mainstream print management software for enterprises and educational institutions, providing cross-platform print job monitoring, cost allocation, quota management, and device status management. The software integrates existing directory services to unify user identity management and uses a web-based management console to allow administrators to remotely configure print policies, audit logs, and system parameters. As a core component of document output infrastructure, it is widely used in government, healthcare, and large office network environments, supporting hybrid cloud and on-premises deployment models. Affected versions include specific releases prior to 24.1.10, prior to 25.0.13, and prior to 26.0.5. The vulnerability arises because backend operations are triggered before authentication and access control checks are completed when the web management interface processes management function requests. An unauthenticated remote attacker can directly invoke management endpoints by sending malicious HTTP requests, thereby bypassing normal authentication and making unauthorized changes to system configuration. Successful exploitation may compromise system integrity and create opportunities for subsequent lateral movement or data theft.

patch_add.vuln_name: Composer-不可信仓库依赖执行命令-漏洞(CVE-2026-84361)
patch_add.vuln_name_en: Composer-Untrusted Repository Dependency Command Execution-Vulnerability (CVE-2026-84361)
patch_add.description: Composer 是 PHP 语言的依赖管理工具。从 1.0 到 2.2.30 以及 2.10.3，来自自定义 Composer 存储库的恶意依赖软件包，或来自不受信任的 composer.lock 文件，可能将 source.type 设置为 perforce，并将 source.url 设置为以 rsh: 或 jsh: 开头的 P4PORT 值。当安装了 Perforce p4 客户端，并且 Composer 通过 composer install 或 composer update（包括 --prefer-source）从源码安装该软件包时，Composer\Util\Perforce 会未经验证就将地址传递给 p4，导致 p4 以用户或 CI 账户的权限运行本地命令。Packagist.org 不允许使用 Perforce 源元数据。该问题已在 2.2.30 和 2.10.3 版本中修复。
patch_add.description_en: Composer is a dependency Manager for the PHP language. From 1.0 until 2.2.30 and 2.10.3, a malicious dependency package from a custom Composer repository or an untrusted composer.lock file could set source.type to perforce and source.url to an rsh: or jsh: P4PORT value. When the Perforce p4 client was installed and Composer installed the package from source through composer install or composer update, including --prefer-source, Composer\Util\Perforce passed the address to p4 without validation, causing p4 to run a local command with the privileges of the user or CI account. Packagist.org does not permit Perforce source metadata. This issue is fixed in versions 2.2.30 and 2.10.3.

patch_add.vuln_name: Jenkins 远程代码执行漏洞(CVE-2026-84645)
patch_add.vuln_name_en: Jenkins Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (CVE-2026-84645)
patch_add.technical_category: 代码注入,对象属性修改控制不当
patch_add.description: Jenkins 是一款广泛使用的开源自动化服务器，主要用于支撑软件开发的持续集成与持续交付（CI/CD）流程。它提供了丰富的插件生态和灵活的配置能力，能够帮助开发团队自动化完成代码构建、测试、部署及监控任务。作为 DevOps 体系中的核心组件，Jenkins 通过 Web 界面和配置文件管理各类作业、流水线及全局系统设置，广泛应用于企业级软件开发环境。在受影响版本中，标记为将配置存储在独立顶级配置文件中的对象类型（如全局配置和作业）可被嵌入为用户提交的 `config.xml` 文档中的嵌套字段值。这些对象随后经由 Stapler Web 框架处理 HTTP 请求，由于系统未对嵌套配置对象的类型与访问路径实施充分校验，攻击者能够构造恶意配置数据，最终在服务器端执行任意代码并完全控制目标系统。
patch_add.description_en: Jenkins is a widely used open-source automation server, mainly used to support the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) processes of software development. It provides a rich plugin ecosystem and flexible configuration capabilities, helping development teams automate code building, testing, deployment, and monitoring tasks. As a core component of the DevOps system, Jenkins manages jobs, pipelines, and global system settings through a web interface and configuration files, and is widely used in enterprise software development environments. In affected versions, object types marked to store configurations in separate top-level configuration files (such as global configurations and jobs) can be embedded as nested field values in user-submitted `config.xml` documents. These objects are then processed by the Stapler web framework via HTTP requests, and since the system does not perform sufficient validation on the types and access paths of nested configuration objects, attackers can construct malicious configuration data to eventually execute arbitrary code on the server and fully control the target system.

patch_add.vuln_name_en: Welcart e-Commerce Stored Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability (CVE-2026-19914)
patch_add.description: WordPress 的 Welcart e-Commerce 插件在所有 2.12.1 及更早版本中，由于对 'custom_order' 参数缺乏足够的输入清理和输出转义，存在存储型跨站脚本漏洞。这使得未经身份验证的攻击者能够在页面中注入任意的 Web 脚本，当用户访问被注入的页面时将会执行。注入的载荷通过访客结账表单交付，无需任何身份验证，当管理员在 WordPress 管理面板中查看受影响的订单时执行。
patch_add.description_en: The Welcart e-Commerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'custom_order' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.12.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The injected payload is delivered via the guest checkout form, requiring no authentication, and executes when an administrator views the affected order in the WordPress admin panel.

patch_add.vuln_name_en: Kyverno policy bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-84200)
patch_add.description: Kyverno 版本 v1.9.0 至 v1.12.7 存在策略例外处理缺陷。当处于 enforce 模式的策略与两个 PolicyException 结合使用时，限制较少的例外将优先生效，攻击者可以通过构造匹配第二个例外名称模式（例如 `*ingress*`）的资源名称来绕过该策略。这可用于绕过诸如阻止 hostPath 卷等策略。已在 v1.13.0 中修复。
patch_add.description_en: Kyverno versions v1.9.0 through v1.12.7 contain a policy exception handling flaw. When a policy in enforce mode is combined with two PolicyExceptions, the less restrictive exception takes precedence, allowing an attacker to bypass the policy by crafting a resource name that matches the second exception's name pattern (e.g., '*ingress*'). This can be used to circumvent policies such as one blocking hostPath volumes. Fixed in v1.13.0.

patch_add.vuln_name_en: gRPC-Go Heap Memory Exhaustion Vulnerability (CVE-2026-84304)
patch_add.description: gRPC-Go 是 gRPC 的 Go 语言实现。在 1.83.1 之前，internal/transport/transport.go 将每个分片的 HTTP/2 DATA 帧作为单独的 recvMsg 存储在 recvBuffer 中，因此即使有效负载字节仍处于连接和流控窗口内，数百万个一字节帧仍可能导致堆内存消耗不成比例。未经身份验证的远程攻击者可以利用并发多路复用流耗尽进程内存，并导致运行时panic或内存溢出终止。接收缓冲区压缩默认已启用，并可通过 GRPC_GO_EXPERIMENTAL_ENABLE_RECEIVE_BUFFER_COMPACTION 临时控制。该问题已在 1.83.1 版本中修复。
patch_add.description_en: gRPC-Go is the Go language implementation of gRPC. Prior to 1.83.1, internal/transport/transport.go stores each fragmented HTTP/2 DATA frame as a separate recvMsg in recvBuffer, so millions of one-byte frames can consume disproportionate heap memory even when payload bytes remain within connection and stream flow-control windows. An unauthenticated remote attacker can use concurrent multiplexed streams to exhaust process memory and cause a runtime panic or out-of-memory termination. Receive-buffer compaction is enabled by default and can be controlled temporarily with GRPC_GO_EXPERIMENTAL_ENABLE_RECEIVE_BUFFER_COMPACTION. This issue is fixed in version 1.83.1.

patch_add.vuln_name: Tornado请求体耗尽事件循环漏洞(CVE-2026-82397)
patch_add.vuln_name_en: Tornado request body exhaustion event loop vulnerability (CVE-2026-82397)
patch_add.technical_category: 不受控的资源消耗,输入中指定数量的不正确验证
patch_add.description: Tornado 是 Python 的 Web 框架和异步网络库。在 6.5.8 之前，Tornado 在 tornado/escape.py 中使用 urllib.parse.parse_qs 解析 application/x-www-form-urlencoded 请求体，但未传递 max_num_fields 参数。tornado/web.py 中的 RequestHandler._execute 会通过 HTTPServerRequest._parse_body 和 tornado/httputil.py 中的 parse_body_arguments 在处理程序分发之前解析请求体，因此一个未经身份验证的请求体中包含数百万个以分隔符分隔的字段时，可能会同步阻塞单线程事件循环，并延迟所有连接。请求体的大小仅受 max_buffer_size 限制，默认值为 104857600 字节。该问题已在 6.5.8 版本中修复。
patch_add.description_en: Tornado is a Python web framework and asynchronous networking library. Prior to 6.5.8, Tornado parses application/x-www-form-urlencoded request bodies with urllib.parse.parse_qs in tornado/escape.py without passing max_num_fields. RequestHandler._execute in tornado/web.py parses the body before handler dispatch through HTTPServerRequest._parse_body and parse_body_arguments in tornado/httputil.py, so an unauthenticated request body containing millions of separator-delimited fields can synchronously stall the single-threaded event loop and delay every connection. The body is bounded only by max_buffer_size, which defaults to 104857600 bytes. This issue is fixed in version 6.5.8.

patch_add.vuln_name_en: pnpm Path Traversal and File Overwrite Vulnerability (CVE-2026-82393)
patch_add.threat_category: 信息泄露,代码执行,拒绝服务
patch_add.technical_category: 代码注入,路径名的限制不恰当,文件名或路径的外部可控制
patch_add.description: pnpm 是一个软件包管理器。在 10.34.5 和 11.11.0 之前，pnpm 会接受 tarball 依赖项的 package.json 说明文件中作用域路径穿越的名称，因为 pnpm11/resolving/npm-resolver/src/pickPackage.ts 仅对非作用域名称拒绝斜杠字符。在 pnpm install 期间，未经过验证的名称会直接进入 pnpm11/installing/deps-resolver/src/resolvePeers.ts、pnpm11/installing/deps-resolver/src/index.ts 和 pnpm11/deps/graph-builder/src/lockfileToDepGraph.ts 中的原始路径拼接，导致软件包被解压到 node_modules 之外，并使攻击者控制的文件能够覆盖任意文件系统路径，即使使用了 --ignore-scripts 也会如此。这种覆盖可能替换 shell 启动文件、Git Hooks 或已安装软件包代码，并导致代码执行。该问题已在 10.34.5 和 11.11.0 版本中修复。
patch_add.description_en: pnpm is a package manager. Prior to 10.34.5 and 11.11.0, pnpm accepts a scoped path traversal in a tarball dependency's package.json manifest name because pnpm11/resolving/npm-resolver/src/pickPackage.ts rejects slash characters only for unscoped names. During pnpm install, the unvalidated name reaches raw path joins in pnpm11/installing/deps-resolver/src/resolvePeers.ts, pnpm11/installing/deps-resolver/src/index.ts, and pnpm11/deps/graph-builder/src/lockfileToDepGraph.ts, causing package extraction outside node_modules and allowing attacker-controlled files to overwrite arbitrary filesystem paths even when --ignore-scripts is used. The overwrite can replace shell startup files, Git hooks, or installed package code and lead to code execution. This issue is fixed in versions 10.34.5, and 11.11.0.
patch_add.vuln_type: 信息泄露,代码执行,拒绝服务

patch_add.vuln_name: EasyAdmin仪表板路由控制器替换绕过漏洞(CVE-2026-81892)
patch_add.vuln_name_en: EasyAdmin dashboard route controller replacement bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-81892)
patch_add.threat_category: 权限提升,身份认证绕过
patch_add.technical_category: 可控密钥绕过授权,授权机制不正确,未授权访问,通过用户可控密钥绕过授权
patch_add.description: EasyAdmin 是用于 Symfony 应用的快速且现代化的后台生成器。从 4.0.0 到 4.29.16 以及 5.5.1 之前，EasyAdmin 通过单个仪表板路由处理所有后台请求，并且针对自定义操作（Action::linkToRoute() 和 MenuItem::linkToRoute()），会基于 kernel.controller 事件上的 routeName 查询参数交换执行的控制器。此交换发生在 Symfony 的安全防火墙已经针对原始仪表板 URL 评估了 access_control 之后，而且 routeName 值未经验证。结果就是，针对目标路由的路径式 access_control 规则从未被评估，因此，能够访问单个 EasyAdmin URL 且知道目标路由名称的低权限后台用户，可以执行该路由的控制器，从而绕过基于路径的规则。只有基于路径的保护会被绕过。其控制器使用 #[IsGranted] 或 denyAccessUnlessGranted() 强制执行自身授权的路由仍受到保护，因为这些检查会针对被替换进来的控制器重新计算。该问题已在 4.29.16 和 5.5.1 版本中修复。
patch_add.description_en: EasyAdmin is a fast and modern admin generator for Symfony applications. From 4.0.0 until 4.29.16 and 5.5.1, EasyAdmin serves all backend requests through a single dashboard route and, for custom actions (Action::linkToRoute() and MenuItem::linkToRoute()), swaps the executed controller based on the routeName query parameter on the kernel.controller event. The swap happens after Symfony's security firewall has already evaluated access_control against the original dashboard URL, and the routeName value was not validated. As a result, a path-based access_control rule protecting the target route was never evaluated, so a low-privilege backend user who can reach a single EasyAdmin URL and knows a target route's name can execute that route's controller, bypassing the path-based rule. Only path-based protections are bypassed. Routes whose controller enforces its own authorization with #[IsGranted] or denyAccessUnlessGranted() remain protected because those checks are recomputed against the swapped-in controller. This issue is fixed in versions 4.29.16 and 5.5.1.
patch_add.vuln_type: 权限提升,身份认证绕过

patch_add.vuln_name_en: elFinder arbitrary file upload vulnerability (CVE-2026-81891)
patch_add.description: elFinder 是一个面向 Web 的开源文件管理器，使用 JavaScript 配合 jQuery UI 编写。在 2.1.70 之前，`php/elFinderVolumeDriver.class.php` 中的 `checkExtractItems()` 会调用 `mimetypeInternalDetect()`，但未将结果通过 `mimeTypeNormalize()` 进行处理。由于 `.phtml`、`.phar`、`.php5` 和 `.php3` 扩展名未出现在 `mime.types` 中，因此将上述扩展名映射到 `text/x-php` 的 `staticMimeMap` 条目不会被应用，而 `allowPutMime()` 即使 `uploadDeny` 已阻止 `text/x-php`，仍然允许执行解压。具有 ZIP 上传权限的攻击者可将可执行 PHP 文件解压到 Web 可访问的 `files/` 目录中，并在服务器执行这些扩展名时实现远程代码执行。该问题已在版本 2.1.70 中修复。
patch_add.description_en: elFinder is an open-source file manager for web, written in JavaScript using jQuery UI. Prior to 2.1.70, checkExtractItems() in php/elFinderVolumeDriver.class.php calls mimetypeInternalDetect() without passing the result through mimeTypeNormalize(). Because the .phtml, .phar, .php5, and .php3 extensions are absent from mime.types, the staticMimeMap entries that map them to text/x-php are not applied, and allowPutMime() permits extraction even when uploadDeny blocks text/x-php. An attacker with ZIP upload permission can extract PHP-executable files into a web-accessible files/ directory and achieve remote code execution when the server executes those extensions. This issue is fixed in version 2.1.70.

patch_add.vuln_name_en: Wallos Unprivileged Migration Execution Vulnerability (CVE-2026-54598)
patch_add.technical_category: 关键功能的认证机制缺失
patch_add.description: Wallos 是一款开源、可自托管的个人订阅追踪工具。在 4.9.4 版本之前，`/endpoints/db/migrate.php` 在通过 HTTP 调用且无需任何认证的情况下会执行数据库模式迁移。任何未经身份验证的攻击者都可以针对生产环境的 SQLite 数据库触发待处理的迁移文件。该问题已在 4.9.4 版本中修复。
patch_add.description_en: Wallos is an open-source, self-hostable personal subscription tracker. Prior to version 4.9.4, endpoints/db/migrate.php executes database schema migrations when called over HTTP with zero authentication. Any unauthenticated attacker can trigger pending migration files against the live SQLite database. This issue has been patched in version 4.9.4.

patch_add.vuln_name_en: fast-uri IPv6 literal parsing bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-75975)
patch_add.threat_category: 安全特性绕过,代码执行,信息泄露,拒绝服务
patch_add.technical_category: 数据验证不恰当,服务器端请求伪造
patch_add.description: fast-uri 是 Node.js 的一个 URI 解析器。其对括号包裹的 IPv6 字面量的自定义解析器没有验证完整的 IPv6 语法，因此 authority 中的无效尾部文本可能被静默丢弃，而一个格式错误的、由攻击者控制的 host 会被转换成另一个不同的有效 IPv6 目标。例如，带有无效尾部字符的括号字面量会被规范化为未指定地址，随后 Node HTTP 客户端会通过回环连接到本地服务，而其他格式错误的字面量则会坍缩为私有地址段地址。解析结果的错误字段不会设置错误，因此检查错误字段的应用程序无法检测到这一重写。在对出站请求、重定向、代理路由或地址策略执行之前对不受信任的 URL 进行规范化的应用程序，可能会被重定向到本地或私有 IPv6 目标，从而形成服务端请求伪造以及绕过地址策略的原语。受影响的版本为 2.3.1 至低于 2.4.5、3.0.0 至低于 3.1.6，以及 4.0.0 至低于 4.1.3。该问题已在 2.4.5、3.1.6 和 4.1.3 中修复，这些版本会对括号包裹的 IP 字面量进行完整语法校验，并将格式错误的字面量标记为 authority 错误。用户应升级到已修复版本。
patch_add.description_en: fast-uri is a URI parser for Node.js. Its custom parser for bracketed IPv6 literals does not validate the complete IPv6 grammar, so invalid trailing text in an authority can be silently discarded and a malformed attacker-controlled host is turned into a different valid IPv6 destination. For example, a bracketed literal with invalid trailing characters is normalized to the unspecified address, which a Node HTTP client then connects to a local service over loopback, and other malformed literals collapse to private-range addresses. No error is set on the parsed result, so an application checking the error field cannot detect the rewrite. An application that normalizes untrusted URLs before outbound requests, redirects, proxy routing, or address-policy enforcement can be redirected to a local or private IPv6 target, giving a server-side request forgery and address-policy bypass primitive. The affected versions are 2.3.1 up to but not including 2.4.5, 3.0.0 up to but not including 3.1.6, and 4.0.0 up to but not including 4.1.3. The issue is fixed in 2.4.5, 3.1.6, and 4.1.3, which validate bracketed IP literals against the full grammar and mark malformed literals as authority errors. Users should upgrade to a patched version.
patch_add.vuln_type: 安全特性绕过,代码执行,信息泄露,拒绝服务

patch_add.vuln_name: Grav动态数据回调执行漏洞(CVE-2026-64850)
patch_add.vuln_name_en: Grav dynamic data callback execution vulnerability (CVE-2026-64850)
patch_add.description: Grav 是一个基于文件的 Web 平台。在 2.0.7 之前，Grav Blueprint::dynamicData() 位于 system/src/Grav/Common/Data/Blueprint.php，会将编辑器控制的 Class::method 提供者和参数传递给 call_user_func_array()，且不会拒绝危险的回调参数。拥有 admin.pages 或 api.pages.write 权限的账户可以使用 Grav\Common\Utils::arrayFilterRecursive() 作为跳转点，并以 system 作为回调，将命令放入页面 frontmatter，并在页面被查看时以 web server 用户身份执行该命令。此问题已在版本 2.0.7 中修复。
patch_add.description_en: Grav is a file-based Web platform. Prior to 2.0.7, Grav Blueprint::dynamicData() in system/src/Grav/Common/Data/Blueprint.php sends an editor-controlled Class::method provider and arguments to call_user_func_array() without rejecting dangerous callback parameters. An account with admin.pages or api.pages.write can use Grav\Common\Utils::arrayFilterRecursive() as a trampoline with system as the callback, place a command in page frontmatter, and execute that command as the web server user when the page is viewed. This issue is fixed in version 2.0.7.

patch_add.vuln_name: Orval模板注入代码执行漏洞(CVE-2026-72716)
patch_add.vuln_name_en: Orval template injection code execution vulnerability (CVE-2026-72716)
patch_add.technical_category: 模板引擎中使用的特殊元素的不当中和
patch_add.description: Orval 会基于 OpenAPI v3 和 Swagger v2 规范，在 TypeScript 中生成类型安全的 JavaScript 客户端。在 8.21.0 之前，查询参数默认值中的 `${...}` 表达式或反引号会在 zod 模式生成过程中被输出到模块级模板字符串中，且未经过安全编码。当导入生成的 zod 模式模块时，这会导致攻击者控制的 JavaScript 被求值，从而在开发人员、CI、测试或应用环境中执行代码。受影响的代码是 `packages/zod/src/index.ts` 函数 `formatDefaultValue`。该问题已在 8.21.0 版本中修复。
patch_add.description_en: Orval generates type-safe JavaScript clients in TypeScript from OpenAPI v3 and Swagger v2 specifications. Prior to 8.21.0, a ${...} expression or backtick in a query parameter default is emitted into a module-level template literal emitted by zod schema generation without safe encoding. This permits attacker-controlled JavaScript to be evaluated when the generated zod schema module is imported, resulting in code execution in the developer, CI, test, or application environment. The affected code is packages/zod/src/index.ts function formatDefaultValue. This issue is fixed in version 8.21.0.

patch_add.vuln_name_en: nanoid-CSPRNG offset corruption vulnerability (CVE-2026-73086)
patch_add.threat_category: 代码执行, 拒绝服务
patch_add.description: nanoid 是 JavaScript 的一种安全、URL 友好的唯一字符串 ID 生成器。在 3.3.12 和 5.1.11 之前的版本中，`index.js` 和 `index.cjs` 中的 `nanoid(size)` 函数会将受用户影响的 `size` 参数强制转换为有符号 32 位整数，使得 `2147483648` 变为 `-2147483648`，并破坏进程范围的 CSPRNG `poolOffset`，这会导致在进程重启前，后续会话令牌、CSRF 令牌、API 密钥和唯一标识符都变成确定性的字符串 `"uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu"`。该问题已在 3.3.12 和 5.1.11 版本中修复。
patch_add.description_en: nanoid is a secure, URL-friendly, unique string ID generator for JavaScript. Prior to versions 3.3.12 and 5.1.11, the nanoid(size) function in index.js and index.cjs coerces the user-influenced size parameter to a signed 32-bit integer, allowing a value of 2147483648 to become -2147483648 and corrupt the process-wide CSPRNG poolOffset in fillPool(), which causes subsequent session tokens, CSRF tokens, API keys, and unique identifiers to become the deterministic string "uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu" until the process restarts. This issue is fixed in versions 3.3.12 and 5.1.11.
patch_add.vuln_type: 代码执行, 拒绝服务

patch_add.vuln_name_en: Mistune deep nested DOS vulnerability (CVE-2026-76098)
patch_add.description: Mistune 是一款带有渲染器和插件的 Python Markdown 解析器。3.3.0 至 3.3.2 版本存在 DoS 漏洞，可通过深度嵌套的 token 触发。HTML 渲染会从连续的星号字符中创建深度嵌套的强调 token，而 HTMLRenderer.render_token() 中的递归渲染可能超出 Python 的递归限制并引发 RecursionError，导致精心构造的 Markdown 可崩溃解析过程。该问题已在 3.3.3 版本中修复。
patch_add.description_en: Mistune is a Python Markdown parser with renderers and plugins. Versions 3.3.0 through 3.3.2 are vulnerable to DoS through deeply nested tokens. HTML rendering creates deeply nested emphasis tokens from consecutive asterisk characters, and recursive rendering in HTMLRenderer.render_token() can exceed Python's recursion limit and raise RecursionError, allowing crafted Markdown to crash a parsing process. This issue is fixed in version 3.3.3

patch_add.vuln_name: Pointter PHP Micro-Blogging Social Network 认证绕过漏洞(CVE-2010-4333)
patch_add.vuln_name_en: Pointter PHP Micro-Blogging Social Network  Authentication Bypass Vulnerability (CVE-2010-4333)
patch_add.description: Pointter PHP Micro-Blogging Social Network是一个PHP编写的微型博客社交网络系统。该系统允许用户发布和分享信息，并具有社交网络功能。在1.8版本中，由于对用户认证的处理不当，远程攻击者可以通过设置auser和apass两个cookie的任意值来绕过身份验证，从而获得管理员权限。
patch_add.description_en: Pointter PHP Micro-Blogging Social Network is a PHP-based micro-blogging social network system. The system allows users to post and share information and has social networking features. In version 1.8, due to improper handling of user authentication, remote attackers can bypass authentication by setting the values of the auser and apass cookies arbitrarily, thus obtaining administrative privileges.

patch_add.vuln_name_en: Listdom stored XSS vulnerability (CVE-2026-19796)
patch_add.description: WordPress 插件 Listdom：由 AI 驱动的分类广告目录插件（AI-powered Business Directory with Classifieds Ads Listings）在 5.8.1 及所有更早版本中，由于对 `lsd[displ][style]` 参数缺乏足够的输入过滤和输出转义，存在存储型跨站脚本漏洞。这使得未经身份验证的攻击者能够在页面中注入任意 Web 脚本，当用户访问被注入的页面时脚本就会执行。成功利用该漏洞需要 Listdom Pro 附加组件处于激活状态，并启用“Display Options Per Listing displ”设置，这两项均为非默认配置。
patch_add.description_en: The Listdom: AI-powered Business Directory with Classifieds Ads Listings plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via 'lsd[displ][style]' Parameter in all versions up to, and including, 5.8.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires the Listdom Pro add-on to be active and the 'Display Options Per Listing' displ setting to be enabled, both of which are non-default configurations.

patch_add.vuln_name_en: hulumi privilege escalation vulnerability (CVE-2026-82857)
patch_add.description: hulumi 在 v1.3.2 之前的版本中，在每周集成 IAM 策略中存在权限提升漏洞，允许对 af-e2e-* 角色执行角色生命周期操作，且缺乏足够的边界限制。具有文档中记录的主词的攻击者可以在沙箱账户中创建持久的高权限角色。
patch_add.description_en: hulumi versions before v1.3.2 contain a privilege escalation vulnerability in the weekly integration IAM policy that allows role lifecycle operations on af-e2e-* roles without sufficient boundary restrictions. Attackers with the documented principal can create persistent higher-privilege roles in the sandbox account.

patch_add.vuln_name_en: pnpm lock file package name verification vulnerability (CVE-2026-82392)
patch_add.threat_category: 信息泄露,代码执行,拒绝服务
patch_add.description: pnpm 是一个软件包管理器。在 10.34.5 之前以及 11.0.0 至 11.11.0 期间，pnpm 会从攻击者可控的 `pnpm-lock.yaml` 包的键中解析包名，使用方式为 `dp.parse(depPath).name`，并在 `deps/graph-builder/src/lockfileToDepGraph.ts` 与 `pnpm11/deps/graph-builder/src/lockfileToDepGraph.ts` 中未经过验证便使用该包名。该包名随后进入 `path.join(modules, pkgName)`、`storeController.importPackage` 以及 `pnpm11/lockfile/to-pnp/src/index.ts`，导致用户在运行 `pnpm install` 时，软件包内容可能被写入 `node_modules` 之外。当 `dangerouslyAllowAllBuilds` 或匹配的 `allowBuilds` 条目允许生命周期脚本时，被转义的包便可以用户的权限执行代码。该问题已在版本 10.34.5 和 11.11.0 中修复。
patch_add.description_en: pnpm is a package manager. Prior to 10.34.5 and from 11.0.0 until 11.11.0, pnpm parses the package name from attacker-controlled pnpm-lock.yaml packages keys with dp.parse(depPath).name and uses it without validation in deps/graph-builder/src/lockfileToDepGraph.ts and pnpm11/deps/graph-builder/src/lockfileToDepGraph.ts. The name reaches path.join(modules, pkgName), storeController.importPackage, and pnpm11/lockfile/to-pnp/src/index.ts, allowing package contents to be written outside node_modules when a user runs pnpm install. When dangerouslyAllowAllBuilds or a matching allowBuilds entry permits lifecycle scripts, the escaped package can execute code with the user's privileges. This issue is fixed in versions 10.34.5 and 11.11.0.
patch_add.vuln_type: 信息泄露,代码执行,拒绝服务

patch_add.vuln_name_en: ash_typescript-RPC field Atom exhaustion vulnerability (CVE-2026-74837)
patch_add.description:
ash-project ash_typescript 中存在不受限制或节流分配资源漏洞，未经身份验证的攻击者可通过客户端提供的 RPC 字段名称耗尽 BEAM atom 表并导致节点中止。

lib/ash_typescript/field_formatter.ex 中的 AshTypescript.FieldFormatter.convert_to_field_atom/2 会把客户端提供的字段名称转换为 atom；当不存在匹配的 atom 时会调用 String.to_atom/1。它会先委托给 parse_input_field/2，后者通过 String.to_existing_atom/1 解析名称，并在无匹配时回退返回原始字符串；convert_to_field_atom/2 随后会基于该字符串创建一个 atom，而不是将该名称视为未知字段。

RPC 字段选择会经由 AshTypescript.Rpc.FieldProcessing.FieldSelector 对每个 requested field name 调用该逻辑；它在检查字段是否存在之前会先解析每个名称，且没有任何白名单、长度限制或速率限制。atom 不会被垃圾回收，因此每个不同名称都会永久创建一个 atom，当 atom 表达到上限时 VM 会中止。超过 255 个字符的字段名称还会触发一个未捕获的 SystemLimitError。

该问题影响 ash_typescript：0.1.0 至 0.18.0 之前的版本。
patch_add.description_en:
Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling vulnerability in ash-project ash_typescript allows an unauthenticated attacker to exhaust the BEAM atom table and abort the node via client-supplied RPC field names.

AshTypescript.FieldFormatter.convert_to_field_atom/2 in lib/ash_typescript/field_formatter.ex converts a client-supplied field name to an atom with String.to_atom/1 when no matching atom already exists. It delegates first to parse_input_field/2, which resolves the name with String.to_existing_atom/1 and falls back to returning the plain string; convert_to_field_atom/2 then mints an atom from that string rather than treating the name as unknown.

RPC field selection reaches it for every requested field name through AshTypescript.Rpc.FieldProcessing.FieldSelector, which resolves each name before checking that the field exists, with no allowlist, length bound, or rate limit. Atoms are never garbage collected, so each distinct name mints a permanent one and the VM aborts once the atom table limit is reached. A field name over 255 characters additionally raises an uncaught SystemLimitError.

This issue affects ash_typescript: from 0.1.0 before 0.18.0.

patch_add.vuln_name: TYPO3 CMS引用者校验绕过漏洞(CVE-2026-19418)
patch_add.vuln_name_en: TYPO3 CMS referer validation bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-19418)
patch_add.threat_category: 代码执行,信息泄露,身份认证绕过
patch_add.technical_category: 跨站请求伪造,来源认证错误
patch_add.description: 借助 TYPO3-CORE-SA-2020-006 https://news.typo3.com/security/advisory/typo3-core-sa-2020-006 （CVE-2020-11069 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord）引入的来源站点校验，在 TYPO3 v13.0 中已失效。自该版本起，TYPO3 CMS 开始从站点的主入口脚本提供后台和 Install Tool 应用，而不是原先专用的 typo3/ 目录。原本通过将来源站点与入口脚本所在目录进行比较，来判断请求是否来自后台或 Install Tool 本身；而自此之后，比较对象改为了站点根目录。结果是，来自 TYPO3 实例自身任意域上脚本的请求，例如来自前端页面，都会被后台路由和 Install Tool 端点接受。攻击者若能在其中一个域上执行 JavaScript，例如通过利用跨站脚本漏洞，便可通过 Fetch/XHR 以已认证受害者用户会话的权限调用这些端点。该问题影响 TYPO3 CMS 13.0.0-13.4.33 以及 14.0.0-14.3.5 版本。
patch_add.description_en: The referrer enforcement introduced with  TYPO3-CORE-SA-2020-006 https://news.typo3.com/security/advisory/typo3-core-sa-2020-006  ( CVE-2020-11069 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord ) became ineffective in TYPO3 v13.0, where TYPO3 CMS started serving the backend and Install Tool applications from the site's main entry script instead of the dedicated typo3/ directory. Whether a request originated from the backend or Install Tool itself was determined by comparing the referrer against the directory of the entry script, which since then is the site root. As a consequence, requests originating from any script running on one of the TYPO3 instance's own domains, such as a frontend page, were accepted by backend routes and Install Tool endpoints. Attackers able to execute JavaScript on one of those domains, for instance by exploiting a cross-site scripting vulnerability, could invoke these endpoints via Fetch/XHR with the privileges of an authenticated victim's user session. This issue affects TYPO3 CMS versions 13.0.0-13.4.33 and 14.0.0-14.3.5.

patch_add.vuln_name: Browserslist缓存无界内存耗尽漏洞(CVE-2026-73089)
patch_add.vuln_name_en: Browserslist cache unbounded memory exhaustion vulnerability (CVE-2026-73089)
patch_add.description: Browserslist 是一个配置工具，用于在前端工具之间共享目标浏览器及 Node.js 版本。在 4.28.7 之前，index.js 会在 cache 中保留每一个distinct `(queries, context)` 结果，并在 parseCache 中保留每一个 parseQueries() AST，且没有大小限制、TTL 或淘汰机制，允许攻击者能够影响重复的 browserslist() 查询值（包括自 `<year>-<month>-<day>` 起有效的查询）时，绕过调用方控制的 BROWSERSLIST_DISABLE_CACHE 缓解措施，并导致内存线性增长，随后因出内存而导致进程崩溃。该问题已在 4.28.7 版本中修复。
patch_add.description_en: Browserslist is a configuration tool for sharing target browsers and Node.js versions between front-end tools. Prior to 4.28.7, index.js retains every distinct `(queries, context)` result in cache and every parseQueries() AST in parseCache without a size cap, TTL, or eviction, allowing an attacker who can influence repeated browserslist() query values, including valid since `<year>-<month>-<day>` queries, to bypass the caller-controlled BROWSERSLIST_DISABLE_CACHE mitigation and cause linear memory growth followed by an out-of-memory process crash. This issue is fixed in version 4.28.7.
